jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Eastern Europe
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

At TRM Labs, our Deployment Strategy team is on the front lines of customer experience – bridging product expertise with exceptional customer support. The team ensures our customers receive timely, accurate, and high-quality assistance at every step. You will work daily with leading financial institutions and crypto exchanges, — providing value through expert guidance, responsive support, and trusted partnership.

As a Deployment Strategist (Eastern Europe), you will play a critical role in helping TRM customers realise the full value of our platform. You will partner with crypto businesses to trace illicit funds, operationalise scalable compliance programs, and disrupt financial crime across the crypto ecosystem. You will manage a portfolio of strategic accounts, driving adoption of TRM’s tools, and ensuring customers achieve measurable, long-term impact.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Act as a trusted advisor, enabling and crypto businesses to maximise the effectiveness of our platform within their investigative, supervisory, risk, and compliance functions.

  • Confidently explain complex technical and investigative concepts, supporting customer teams in interpreting blockchain data, building cases, and conducting financial crime investigations.

  • Build and deliver product demonstrations tailored to investigators, analysts, compliance officers, supervisors, and risk teams across the private sectors, showing how TRM can be used in real scenarios to uncover networks, follow the money, and disrupt financial crime.

  • Conduct structured training sessions to ensure TRM is embedded into customers’ day-to-day investigative and compliance programs.

  • Serve as the “Voice of the Customer” by channeling customer feedback to product and engineering teams to influence product direction.

  • Monitor customer engagement and usage trends, identifying risks and opportunities to drive measurable outcomes.

  • Proactively identify early signals of churn risk and implement effective mitigation strategies.

  • Establish a consistent engagement cadence with customer stakeholders to understand institutional priorities, regulatory obligations, and emerging risks, proactively addressing challenges before they escalate.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience, ideally within crypto businesses, or financial institutions — preferably in compliance, investigative, or customer-facing functions.

  • High proficiency in English is required. Polish language skills are desirable.

  • Hands-on experience with virtual currencies and blockchain analytics, ideally within a compliance or investigative context; strong appetite to deepen expertise in these areas is essential.

  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, prioritize critical issues, and deliver actionable solutions.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and rigor, particularly in regulatory and investigative contexts.

  • Ability to distill and communicate complex technical and investigative concepts to diverse stakeholders, from compliance officers to senior executives.

  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments where regulatory expectations and priorities evolve quickly.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings

  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for in-person meetings, trainings, or events.

About the Team

  • Our globally distributed Customer Success team collaborates across time zones. This team operates primarily on EMEA time, with occasional later calls to cover US East/West Coast stakeholders on complex opportunities.

  • We work asynchronously by default, with strong documentation and transparent Slack communication.

  • We support customers from onboarding through deep investigations, and our Deployment Strategists are the frontline champions of TRM’s value.

  • This role is an opportunity to scale impactful customer interactions and help shape how we deliver rapid, high-quality support at TRM Labs.

Learn About TRM Speed in This Role

  • Real-Time Client Response: You’ll triage and resolve customer questions during time-sensitive events such as sanctions updates or critical investigations.

  • Expedited Trace Validation: You’ll coordinate with internal teams to validate traces and gather intelligence within hours, ensuring accuracy and speed.

  • Continuous Global Coverage: You’ll contribute to TRM’s 24-hour global support model, ensuring customers always have timely, high-quality assistance no matter their region.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more: Interviewing at TRM: How We Hire and What Success Looks Like

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

jobs.title: Customer Success Application Engineer (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the Role

The Application Engineer is a key technical role within the Litmus Customer Success team and is responsible for ensuring successful configuration, deployment, and value realization of Litmus products for customers across EMEA.

The Application Engineer will work with prospective and existing customers during proof-of-concept projects and production implementations, validating requirements, developing best-practice configurations, and delivering technical outcomes that demonstrate measurable business value.

The Application Engineer will also partner closely with Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, and the Litmus Support Desk to support pre-sales transitions, customer expansion, product feedback, and Level 2 technical support. This role reports to the Director of Technical Delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Validate customer requirements for proof-of-concept and production implementations of Litmus products.

  • Configure Litmus products during proof-of-concepts, customer pilots, and production deployments.

  • Lead assigned technical implementation activities and ensure contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.

  • Develop innovative solution approaches that help customers maximize value from Litmus products.

  • Maintain and contribute to internal solution libraries, deployment best practices, reusable configurations, and technical documentation.

  • Provide Level 2 technical support to the Litmus Service Desk, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and customer issue resolution.

  • Support Sales Engineers and Account Managers with technical architecture reviews, proposal inputs, RFI/RFP responses, demonstrations, and smooth pre-sales-to-implementation handovers.

  • Provide field feedback to Product Management and Development on customer requirements, market gaps, bugs, and product enhancement opportunities.

  • Support webinars, customer meetings, partner enablement, value-added reseller discussions, and customer user group activities as required.

What You’ll Bring

Must Have

  • Professional experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment, ideally in an Application Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation, Controls, Industrial IT/OT, or related technical role.

  • Hands-on experience implementing or supporting software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, or shop-floor solutions in a manufacturing environment.

  • Strong technical understanding of network protocols, system architecture, Linux-based systems, databases, and customer deployment environments.

  • Experience with product configuration, technical troubleshooting, and customer-facing implementation or technical support activities.

  • Working knowledge of scripting or coding using Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.

  • Understanding of containerized and cloud/hybrid infrastructure technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customers, internal technical teams, sales teams, and partners.

  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

  • Fluency in German & English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Litmus products, industrial data platforms, OPC/UA, PLC/SCADA systems, or edge connectivity use cases.

  • Exposure to pre-sales support, solution demonstrations, technical proposal review, RFI/RFP participation, or customer expansion activities.

  • Experience supporting partners, value-added resellers, webinars, customer focus groups, or user-group events.

  • Ability to translate field observations into clear product feedback, enhancement requests, and best-practice documentation.

  • Experience working with industrial protocols, connectivity standards, or OT/IT environments.

  • Enjoys solving complex technical problems, learning new technologies, and helping customers realize measurable business value.

We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

 

What You'll Do

  • Multichannel Outreach: Execute targeted outreach campaigns using phone, email, and LinkedIn/social touches to engage target prospects.

  • Lead Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with key decision-makers—such as CFOs, Travel Managers, and Office Managers—to assess fit and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  • Value Articulation: Clearly communicate Perk’s value proposition and build immediate credibility with prospective clients.

  • CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate prospect data and activity tracking within Salesforce.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing to refine target accounts, test new messaging, and optimize the lead-qualification process.

  • Product Mastery: Stay expert-level on Perk’s product offerings and industry trends.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German with professional fluency in English.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong phone-based rapport-building skills.

  • Sales Acumen: Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales processes or outbound prospect outreach.

  • Process & Execution: High organizational skills, comfort working with CRMs (Salesforce preferred), and a focus on hitting output metrics.

 

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistent Pipeline Generation: You hit and exceed your monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and opportunities created.

  • High Outreach Discipline: You maintain steady, structured daily outreach activity (calls, emails, social touches) using Salesforce and modern sales tools.

  • Value-Driven Discovery: You master Perk’s value proposition early, allowing you to ask smart discovery questions and handle client objections with confidence.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: You collaborate seamlessly with Account Executives to ensure smooth handover of leads and high show-up rates for meetings.

  • Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

 

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen: 30-minute virtual chat with Talent Acquisition.

  2. Role Assessment: 60-minute in-person interview & practical exercise.

  3. Values & Culture Fit: 30-minute virtual interview.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Want to Learn More Before You Apply?

Join our DACH team for The SDR Diaries: DACH Edition to hear directly from our current SDRs about life at Perk! We’ll cover day-to-day responsibilities, live objection handling, real experiences relocating to Barcelona, and tips for navigating our interview process.

 

🔗 Register for the event here: https://luma.com/kztwu46o

How We Set You Up to Succeed (Work Schedule)

  • First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

  • Post-Probation Schedule: Standard hybrid model, 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. jobs.title: Account Executive II DACH
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our DACH Sales Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals and be part of a collaborative and successful sales unit as we scale Pleo's expense management solution. If you're excited about converting new business and are passionate about SaaS outbound sales this is the opportunity for you!

What you'll be doing

As an Account Executive, you will:

  • Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion

  • Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships

  • Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo

  • Become an expert in expense management

  • Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A track record of meeting sales quotas and targets - ideally including sourcing and closing your own deals

  • Great rapport building and confident presentation skills

  • Strong ability to accept feedback and adapt to new situations

  • Experience in outbound sales

  • Background in SaaS sales is preferred - ideally coming from an Account Executive closing role

  • Fluency in English and German

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Sales Manager and work closely with teams in SDRs, Customer Success and Marketing. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to achieving revenue goals. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across product to ensure success

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Close your first key deals to drive impact in new business revenue

  • Build your own pipeline

  • Grow your skills in SaaS sales and expense management, taking on new challenges as Pleo continues to scale

Show the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets

  • Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

  • In the UK, we offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Sales team we offer hybrid working, with up to two days a week from home three days a week in the London office

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We’re trialling MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.

  • The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

  • Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.

  • Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.

After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.

We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

The Opportunity

As Product Manager, you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.

Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.

 

What You'll Do

  • Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.

  • Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.

  • Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.

  • Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.

  • Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.

Your profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.

  • Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.

  • Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.

  • Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.

  • Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

Bonus:

  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.

  • Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.

  • Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.

 

Why Kuro

You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

Explore the technical vision behind Kuro, from processing more than one million construction pages a month to entity resolution, evidence-linked answers, and 3D project graphs. Kuro Product Vision →

 

The process

  1. Talent Acquisition Call — Intro, logistics & fit (30 min)

  2. Impact Call: Deep dive with Jonas & Get to know Product (30 min)

  3. Challenge: A time-boxed product challenge (≤4 hours)

  4. Challenge review and deep dive (60 minutes)

  5. On-site Day — Meet the team and lunch/dinner

    • Culture Interview (30 Min)

    • Meet several team members

    • Go for lunch with the team

  6. Decision

Compensation: €85K – €110K • 0.05% – 0.15%

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 3+ years of experience as a (full-stack) software engineer in a fast-paced environment

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, or developer-facing products.

At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data & AI team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.
 

What you will do
  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of ML, Deep Learning, and LLMs, specifically their application to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and identify novel opportunities to enhance our products.
  • Develop Advanced AI Models: Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis.
  • Build LLM-Powered Features: Develop and implement advanced LLM-based solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual code analysis, fine-tuning models on proprietary codebases, and exploring agentic systems for automated code remediation.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful ML prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven experience in applied Machine Learning, with a strong focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP) or, ideally, Programming Language Processing (PLP).

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.


Job Location

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

Your role at Ocumeda

We are looking for a Product Owner AI (m/f/d) to take ownership of a new AI-based medical device. You will own the product's technical specification, backlog and requirements end-to-end, from feature scoping through implementation and international roll-out, acting as the central point between our medical, regulatory, and AI team. If you're motivated to take ownership of a product and shape it within a growing MedTech company, this role is for you.

  • Own the product end-to-end: from feature scoping through implementation, launch, and international roll-out
  • Translate medical and business requirements into clear technical specifications and a prioritized backlog, based on input from users, markets, and internal stakeholders

  • Own the software requirements specification (SRS) and work closely with our AI team to specify and integrate the MDR-certified AI system into the product
  • Work with the product team to bring the device live across multiple markets on our existing platform, adapting to local requirements where needed


What makes you a great fit

  • You have a technical background or hands-on experience with software/API specifications, and you're comfortable moving fluidly between technical AI/engineering details and the regulatory, medical, and business perspectives, translating in both directions
  • You are motivated to work hands-on in a startup environment, balancing pragmatism with structure
  • You take ownership, work in a structured way, and have the drive to push things forward, while collaborating closely with the team.

jobs.description:
Intro

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

  • Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers.


Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

  • A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs.

  • A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly.


What you will do

  • Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories.

  • Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads.

  • Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products.

  • Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements.

  • Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts.

  • Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery.

  • Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate.

  • Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health.


Nice to Have

  • Based in Berlin, or open to working from our Berlin office periodically.

  • Prior experience collaborating directly with identity vendors, panel providers, or purchase-data suppliers on schema and integration work.


Our Software Stack

  • Jira

Why us?

On top of a competitive package…

jobs.title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.

jobs.title: Stagiaire Member Events - Soho House Paris H/F
Account Management Lead - Editions France
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Line Manager ASIC IP
jobs.description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About the Opportunity







We are recruiting a Line Manager for the Silicon Network IP Development section in Lund, reporting to the Head of Networks & Compute Acceleration Engineering. The team is a key contributor to Ericsson's Radio and RAN Compute product development, driving the development of connectivity and digital hardware solutions that enable next-generation products and services. The team's expertise spans micro-architecture, design, implementation, verification, debug, and integration of advanced communication technologies and plays an important role in shaping the future evolution of Ericsson's networking solutions. As leader of the Lund team, you are expected to coach, mentor, challenge, and develop individuals and cross-functional teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, continuous improvement, and a strong sense of belonging. You will define and execute team strategies aligned with business priorities, secure the long-term development of critical competencies, and create an environment where people can grow, perform, and thrive. You will work closely with architects, technical leaders, project organizations, and stakeholders across Ericsson's global R&D organization. A key part of the role is establishing strong collaboration with peer line managers and engineering teams across sites to drive successful execution, strengthen engineering excellence, and ensure the organization has the capabilities required to meet current and future business needs.  What you will do



•    Drive competence development and long-term workforce planning.•    Build an engaging, inclusive, and high-performing work environment that promotes collaboration, continuous learning, and a strong sense of belonging.•    Enable development and delivery of silicon networking solutions for Ericsson's Radio and RAN Compute products.•    Collaborate with architects and technical leaders to define and evolve future solutions.•    Ensure teams understand and follow established development processes, engineering practices, and quality standards throughout the complete IP lifecycle.•    Support development activities throughout the product lifecycle, from early concepts and architecture to deployment and maintenance when required.•    Enable strong collaboration across development sites, organizations, and technology domains.•    Work closely with peer line managers across sites to support staffing, competence development, and successful execution.•    Be accountable for workforce planning, budget management, and capability investments to support successful delivery and long-term organizational growth.•    Contribute to technology strategy, capability planning, and future evolution across Silicon development.   To be successful in the role you must have



•    Proven leadership experience with a genuine passion for developing people, teams, and organizational capabilities.•    Experience from R&D organizations. Experience in networking, Ethernet, digital hardware, ASIC, FPGA, SoC, or related technologies is considered a strong advantage.•    Strong understanding of product development processes, engineering excellence, and agile ways of working.•    Experience in workforce planning, competence development, and resource management.•    Experience managing budgets, balancing business priorities, and driving organizational performance.•    A strategic mindset combined with the ability to drive execution and deliver results in a complex environment.•    An analytical, structured, and solution-oriented approach.•    A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to lead change and transformation.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundig specialist geriatrische zorg
jobs.description:
Om onze ambitie voor grensverleggende, kwaliteitsvolle zorg waar te maken, zoeken we een Verpleegkundig specialist geriatrische zorg met als uitvalbasis onze Vitaz-campus in Sint-Niklaas. Je combineert klinische expertise met beleidsmatige verantwoordelijkheid en draagt zo bij aan kwaliteitsvolle, veilige en warme zorg voor onze geriatrische patiënten.

- Je werkt binnen de geriatrische zorgsetting m.n de G-diensten, het G-dagziekenhuis, het geriatrisch supporteam en op niet- geriatrische afdelingen. Je werkt in een multidisciplinaire context.
- Je staat mee in voor de uitbouw en opvolging van het zorgprogramma geriatrie binnen het ziekenhuis en werkt hiervoor samen met de hoofdverpleegkundige, collega verpleegkundig specialist geriatrie, de clustermanager en het medisch diensthoofd.
- Je ontwikkelt mee de visie en het beleid aangaande (klinische) geriatrische zorg, dat cluster- en ziekenhuisbreed wordt uitgedragen. Je geeft richting en schrijft beleidsrapporten voor de clustermanager, directie en/of andere bevoegde overheden over thema’s zoals behoeftegestuurde zorg, vrijheidsbeperking, valpreventie, dementie, delier, onco-geriatrie en eigen uitgevoerde activiteiten.
- Je initieert en optimaliseert interprofessionele overlegmomenten, ethische reflecties, expertisevergaderingen, congressen en patiëntengroepbijeenkomsten.
- Je bepaalt kwaliteitsindicatoren en initieert verbeteracties inzake kwaliteit van de domeinspecifieke zorg; in samenwerking met de clustermanager, het medisch diensthoofd en de dienst kwaliteit. Je bereidt teams voor op de zorginspectie geriatrie.
- Je versterkt het transmuraal netwerk dat relevant is voor het zorgprogramma zoals de begeleidingscommissies thuiszorg en woonzorg, de seniorenadviesraden,…
- Je vervult een consultfunctie voor verpleegkundigen, (transmurale) zorgverleners, patiënten en hun naasten gericht op geriatrische zorg en het bevorderen van zelfmanagement (autonomie, levenskwaliteit, empowerment). Hiervoor maak je gebruik van gedragstheoretisch onderbouwde en motiverende (gesprek)methoden.
- Je identificeert en speelt in op zorgnoden, -behoeften en op kwetsbaarheden en stelt een zorgplan op voor deze specifieke patiëntengroep en zijn naasten. In samenspraak met de behandelende arts en andere zorgverleners ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de monitoring en bijsturing van dit zorgplan, met het oog op kwaliteitsvolle en patiëntveilige zorg.
- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van de nodige kennis en expertise omtrent het zorgprogramma geriatrie. Je staat verpleegkundig(en), - consulenten bij in de ontwikkeling van de nodige kennisverwerving en innovatieve inzichten, zowel intra- als extramuraal. Je werkt hiervoor samen met de vormingscoördinator.
- Je implementeert en evalueert zorg- en behandelprotocollen, evidence based richtlijnen en initieert actief verpleegwetenschappelijk onderzoek aangaande geriatrische zorg.
- Je begeleidt, samen met de verpleegkundigen, consulenten, collega-specialist, onze bachelor- en masterstudenten verpleegkunde.
- Je werkt actief aan je rolontwikkeling binnen dit specifiek domein en groeit door tot verpleegkundig specialist. Jouw jaren ervaring, professionele ontwikkeling en verworven competenties worden daarbij o.a. in overweging genomen.

- Je hebt een duidelijke visie op geriatrische zorgverlening in een ziekenhuisnetwerk en daarbuiten
- Je hebt een hart voor de geriatrische patiënt, wat zich vertaalt in het streven naar zorg op maat met een hoge klanttevredenheid en in een creatieve, innovatieve benadering van de dienstverlening
- Je behaalde een bachelor verpleegkundige of vroedkunde (afgestudeerd voor 2018) en een master in de verpleegkunde en de vroedkunde of master of science in management, zorg en beleid die jou voorbereidde op een rol als verpleegkundig specialist (of je bent deze opleiding aan het volgen).
- Houder van de bijzondere beroepstitel voor geriatrie is een meerwaarde of je bent bereid je bij te scholen in geriatrische zorg
- Verpleegkundig specialist geriatrische zorg: Je beschikt over minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als verpleegkundige in een (geriatrische) ziekenhuissetting. Daarnaast beschik je ook over een master diploma (cfr bovenstaande).
- Verpleegkundig consulent geriatrische zorg: je beschikt over minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als verpleegkundige in een (geriatrische) setting. Mits positieve evaluatie en het behalen van een master diploma (cfr bovenstaande) kan je groeien tot verpleegkundig specialist.
- Je bent dynamisch, creatief, flexibel en sterk in probleemanalyse en oordeelsvorming.
- Je bent leergierig en volgt actief de evoluties op verpleegwetenschappelijk vlak om op basis hiervan jouw klinische expertise, kennis en competenties continu te verdiepen en te verruimen.
- Je beschikt over de pedagogische kwaliteiten voor een overtuigende en onderbouwde vertaling tussen wetenschap – praktijk.
- Je bent een vlotte teamspeler die efficiënt en doelgericht kan communiceren, samenwerken en sturen, met oog voor een gezamenlijk resultaat op korte en lange termijn
- Je bent gericht op een kwaliteitsvolle zorg- en dienstverlening, met oog voor het efficiënt beheren van toegewezen middelen
- Ook als junior kan je in aanmerking komen. Je bent dan wel bereid een op maat afgestemd vormings- en inlooptraject te volgen zodat je kan uitgroeien tot een volwaardige specialist (zelfstandig een beleids- en visietekst opmaken - communicatie met hoofdverpleegkundigen, artsen en zorgmanagers – expert in het vakdomein)

Voor de overige taakinhouden verwijzen we naar de functieomschrijving 'verpleegkundig specialist'. Interne kandidaten kunnen dit terugvinden op NIKOdoc, externe kandidaten kunnen dit bekomen bij de dienst Personeel & Organisatie.Vacatures Sint-Niklaas:
