jobs.title: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do
  • Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
  • Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
  • Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
  • Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
  • Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
  • Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
  • Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
  • Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
  • You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
  • If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.
  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
  • Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
  • Strong C++ programming skills.
  • Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
  • Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
  • Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
  • Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
  • Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.
  • You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
  • You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
  • You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
  • You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
  • You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

jobs.title: Barnkär personlig assistent sökes till 2-årig tjej i Tyresö – varannan helg
jobs.description:
Jag är en 2-årig flicka som bor i Tyresö tillsammans med mina föräldrar och syskon. Nu söker jag en trygg, engagerad och barnkär personlig assistent som vill bli en del av min vardag.

Tjänsten innebär arbete dagtid varannan helg, cirka 08.00–15.00 både lördag och söndag. Det finns även möjlighet att arbeta extra utöver det särskillt nattpass vid behov.

Jag är en liten tjej med mycket personlighet och behöver en assistent som tycker om att vara nära barn och som kan kombinera lek och energi med lugn, trygghet och ansvar. Jag äter via sond och har andningsövervakning när jag sover, vilket innebär att du behöver vara uppmärksam och noggrann samt kunna följa tydliga rutiner och instruktioner.

Arbetet sker hemma hos mig och min familj. Du kommer inte lämnas ensam i din roll från start, utan får en ordentlig introduktion av våra arbetsledare och stöd i att lära dig mina rutiner och behov.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som:

    Är icke-rökare
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal
    Har erfarenhet av barn och/eller personlig assistans
    Har kunskap i AKK eller är villig att lära dig – detta är ett krav
    Är barnkär, flexibel och ansvarstagande
    Har god fysik, eftersom arbetet bland annat innebär lek, aktivitet och att ibland bära utrustning i trappor
    Är positiv och energisk, men samtidigt lugn, trygg och lyhörd

För oss är personkemin väldigt viktig. Vi söker framför allt någon som vill lära känna mig, skapa en trygg relation och vara en stabil person i min vardag.

Om detta låter som ett arbete för dig ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Om rekryteringsprocessen: Vi tar löpande kontakt med intressanta kandidater och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi alltid en bakgrundskontroll via Fortcheck som skickas ut till dig som kandidat via mejl och sms. jobs.description:
Vi søker etter en fast ansatt til vårt flotte kontor i Tønsberg. Stillingen er hovedsaklig klargjøring og kjøring av bil.

Jobben passer bra for deg som liker å jobbe med biler og logistikk, samtidig som man har god kontroll og trives i en hektisk hverdag.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Klargjøring, skade – og sikkerhetskontroll av biler.

Distribusjon av bil.

 

 

Egenskaper og kvalifikasjoner:

Vi søker deg som er serviceinnstilt, ansvarsfull og pålitelig.

Du må kunne jobbe og trives i hektiske omgivelser.

Gode muntlig/skriftlig kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk.

Jobben krever at du har hatt førerkort i mer enn 1 år.  

 

Vi tilbyr:

Varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

Utviklingsmuligheter innen bransjen.

Et aktivt og hyggelig miljø.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hertz – et ledende bildelingsselskap. Hertz er representert mer enn 150 land på samtlige kontinenter med over 11 000 lokasjoner. Hertz er Norges største bildelingsselskap og en betydelig aktør i den raskt voksende delingsøkonomien. De seneste ti årene har vi hatt en årlig vekst på ca. 20 prosent, og har nå over 500 utleiepunkter, inkludert samtlige flyplasser. Hertz vil være førstevalget innen bilutleie og en markant aktør i den nye delingsøkonomien med heldigitale delings- og mobilitetsløsninger. Vi har store ambisjoner for fremtiden og ser et betydelig vekstpotensial i at stadig flere vil leie og dele biler fremfor å eie selv. Samtlige lokasjoner i Hertz Norge er miljø- og kvalitetssertifisert gjennom standardene ISO 14001, 9001 og 45001 (HMS).

Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.

Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

jobs.title: Propellant Chemist
jobs.description:
Description
About the role

Imagine being at the core of propulsion innovation, shaping the very materials that power our high performance rocket systems. As a Propellant Engineer at Destinus, you will lead the formulation, development, and characterization of solid rocket propellants and thermal protection materials for high-performance rocket motor applications. This role is strongly hands-on and combines materials science, process development, and analytical rigor to deliver reliable, high-quality propulsion materials.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

Develop and optimize solid rocket propellant formulations, balancing performance, mechanical properties, stability, and manufacturability.
Lead laboratory-scale mixing, casting, curing, and post-processing activities in accordance with defined safety and quality standards.
Define and implement characterization methodologies for propellant materials, including mechanical, thermal, rheological, ballistic, ablation and aging evaluations.
Establish and document standard test procedures, acceptance criteria, and data analysis methods for propellant & TPS materials development and qualification.
Support the definition of process parameters and quality control for propellant and TPS manufacturing, including mixing, degassing, casting, curing, and storage.
Analyse formulation trade-offs and drive improvements in performance, robustness, and reproducibility.
Support rocket motor development programs by correlating material properties to motor performance and structural behaviour and thermal environments.
Lead or support investigation of material anomalies, aging effects, or performance deviations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including formulation records, process specifications, characterization reports, and development plans.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, structures, manufacturing, and test teams to ensure seamless integration of propellant materials into motor designs.
Contribute to long-term technology development roadmaps for advanced propellant systems.
Requirements

What You’ll Need
BSc. or MSc. in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in solid rocket propellant development or closely related polymer/composite material systems.
Experience with propellant formulation, mixing, casting, and curing processes.
Strong understanding of polymer-bonded systems, composite materials, and viscoelastic behaviour.
Experience defining and conducting material characterization programs, including mechanical, thermal, and aging testing.
Familiarity with establishing standard operating procedures and structured development processes.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate material data into engineering decisions.
Strong documentation discipline and ability to work in a safety-critical environment.
Ability to work hands-on in laboratory and pilot-scale environments.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Fluency in English required; German is a plus.

Who You Are
You are a propulsion minded materials expert who feels at home in the lab and on the production floor. You understand polymer bonded propellants not just in theory but in practice, from formulation strategy to mixing, casting, curing, and final characterization. You are comfortable defining the technical path forward while also building the processes, documentation, and qualification methods that make materials flight ready and repeatable.

Benefits
Why Join Us?

The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

jobs.title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
jobs.description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

We are seeking a Technical Advisor / Principal Architect to work directly with the CTO on the conception, modeling, and development of breakthrough communication and interconnect technologies.

This is a rare opportunity for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of theory, architecture, and silicon implementation — someone who wants to help shape the future of chip‑to‑chip, die‑to‑die, memory, and networking interconnects.

Role Overview:
You will partner closely with the CTO to explore, evaluate, and prototype next‑generation communication system architectures. This role spans research, modeling, algorithm development, system architecture, and early‑stage silicon feasibility. You will help translate theoretical concepts into implementable designs that can scale into real products.

What You Will Do:
Partner with the CTO to develop next-generation communication and interconnect architectures.
Explore novel signaling, coding, equalization, and system-level techniques.
Build models, simulations, and prototypes to validate architectural concepts.
Evaluate performance, power, latency, area, and manufacturability tradeoffs.
Translate research into silicon-ready architectures and intellectual property.
Identify emerging technologies and opportunities for competitive differentiation.
Provide technical leadership and guidance across research, architecture, and product teams

Required Qualifications:
Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field.
Strong background in digital communications and communication system fundamentals.
Deep understanding of information theory, coding, modulation, and signal processing.
Experience building mathematical models, simulations, or prototypes.
Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar environments.
Ability to work across abstraction levels — from theory to architecture to implementation.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; comfortable exploring unfamiliar domains.

Highly Desirable Experience (streamlined):
SerDes architecture, equalization, or wireline communications.
Coding theory, FEC, or advanced modulation schemes.
System‑level modeling (SystemC or equivalent).
Machine learning applied to communications.
Experience taking concepts from theory to silicon.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate:
Moves fluidly between mathematics, algorithms, architecture, and hardware.
Is willing and able to be hands-on when needed, diving into analysis, modeling, coding, simulation, debugging, or lab work to help move critical projects forward.
Is intellectually curious and thrives on open‑ended technical challenges.
Challenges assumptions and proposes unconventional approaches when needed.
Understands that elegant theory must ultimately translate into manufacturable silicon.

Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Learning Support Assistant
to join the school from: 24.08.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 05.08.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 480 students aged 7 -18 representing 70 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the senior school with a dedicated focus on Year 2-8 students.

The school wishes to appoint a teaching assistant for the junior school to work primarily with students in Years 7 and 8.  Experience of working in an international school context would be a distinct advantage. It is expected that this post will involve supporting approximately 20-30 hours per week. This is a term-time only position.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To support teaching staff in the development and education of pupils including the provision of specialist skills as appropriate.

Support for students (either individually or in groups)
Support the activities of individuals or groups, specifically those with EAL considerations.
Establish and maintain relationships with individual pupils and groups.
Contribute to Individual Education Plans as appropriate.
Support pupils during learning activities.
Promote pupils’ social and emotional development.
Contribute to the health and well-being of pupils.
Provide support for bilingual/multilingual pupils (where appropriate to the focus of the role).
Support children with specific needs (where appropriate to the focus of the role), for example, sensory and/or physical impairment, cognitive or learning difficulties, behavioural, emotional and social development needs, communication and interaction difficulties.
Support for Gifted and Talented pupils.
Support pupils with their literacy and numeracy skills.
Support pupils to access the curriculum.
Dealing with the personal care needs of children where appropriate in line with the guidance of the school.

Support for the teacher(s)
Observe and report on pupil performance.
Contribute to the planning and evaluation of learning activities.
Assist in preparing and maintaining the learning environment.
Contribute to the management of pupils’ behaviour.
Contribute to maintaining pupils’ records.
Support the maintenance of pupils’ safety and security.
Supervise the whole class for a short time in an emergency (normally for a period less than a whole lesson until the teacher returns or alternative arrangements are made) or for a very short period of planned absence for less than a whole lesson.
Undertake routine marking in line with the school policy.
Provide administrative support, e.g. produce worksheets, invigilate examinations, etc.

Support for the School
Support the development and effectiveness of team work within the school environment.
Develop and maintain working relationships with other professionals.
Liaise with parents as appropriate.
Review and develop your own professional practice.

Support for the curriculum
Support the use of information and communication technology in the classroom.
Have a responsibility for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people he/she is responsible for or comes into contact with.
To ensure tasks are carried out with due regard to Health and Safety.
To participate in appropriate professional development including adhering to the principle of appraisal/performance management.
To adhere to the ethos of Aiglon and promote the agreed vision and aims of the school while setting an example of personal integrity and professionalism.
Attendance at appropriate staff meetings, parents/open evenings, etc.
Any other duties as commensurate within the grade in order to ensure the smooth running of Aiglon.
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Deputy Head of the Junior School to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

jobs.description:
Verantwortung übernehmen, Wirkung entfalten – für eine moderne und dienstleistungsorientierte Gemeinde.

Unsere Auftraggeberin - die Gemeinde St. Moritz - gestaltet die nachhaltige Entwicklung des Ortes, schafft verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen und erbringt vielfältige Dienstleistungen für Bevölkerung, Wirtschaft, Politik und weitere Anspruchsgruppen. Die Gemeindeverwaltung nimmt dabei eine zentrale Rolle ein und bewegt sich in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Umfeld. Im Zuge einer Nachfolgeregelung sind wir beauftragt, Sie als fachlich sowie menschlich überzeugende

anzusprechen. Dazu gehören die Vor- und Nachbereitung der Sitzungen, die Protokollführung sowie die redaktionelle Bearbeitung von Botschaften, Anträgen und Beschlüssen. Weiter verantworten Sie Wahlen und Abstimmungen, amtliche Publikationen, das Gemeindearchiv sowie verschiedene Bewilligungs- und Dienstleistungsprozesse. Sie entwickeln die Kanzlei weiter, optimieren Abläufe, treiben die Digitalisierung voran und wirken in abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mit.

Für diese vielseitige Aufgabe verfügen Sie über eine fundierte Aus- und Weiterbildung im Bereich öffentliche Verwaltung, Gemeindeschreiberwesen, Public Management, Recht oder Betriebswirtschaft. Sie bringen mehrjährige Führungserfahrung innerhalb einer Gemeindeverwaltung, einer Gemeindekanzlei, eines Präsidialbereichs, eines Rechtsdienstes oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit. Ein gutes Verständnis für Verwaltungs- und Gemeinderecht, Sicherheit im Umgang mit politischen Behörden und stilsicheres Deutsch setzen wir voraus.

Sind Sie bereit, Ihren beruflichen und persönlichen Lebensmittelpunkt ins Engadin zu verlegen oder St. Moritz als neuen Arbeitsort zu entdecken? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Kontakt: Annette Bamert

jobs.description:
Ref 2579830 \| Date: 18 Sept 2026

![AXEPTA SA]( )

Pour le compte de notre client, **acteur majeur du secteur de l’énergie dans le canton de Fribourg**, nous recherchons un(e) **Technicien(ne) de maintenance CVC** afin de renforcer ses équipes techniques.



Vous intervenez sur des installations de **chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC)** et assurez leur bon fonctionnement, leur maintenance ainsi que leur fiabilité dans le respect des exigences de sécurité et de qualité.

**Technicien de maintenance CVC**

### Vos missions



* Assurer la **maintenance préventive et corrective** des installations CVC.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et identifier les dysfonctionnements.
* Réaliser les interventions de dépannage et de remise en service.
* Effectuer les contrôles, réglages et optimisations des équipements.
* Participer au suivi et à la maintenance des installations de chauffage, ventilation et climatisation.
* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions et renseigner les rapports de maintenance.
* Veiller au respect des procédures de sécurité, des normes en vigueur et des exigences environnementales.
* Collaborer avec les différents intervenants techniques et les équipes d'exploitation.
* Participer, selon les besoins, aux travaux d'amélioration et de modernisation des installations.


### Votre profil



* Formation technique dans le domaine du **CVC, chauffage, climatisation, ventilation ou domaine équivalent**.
* Expérience confirmée dans la **maintenance d'installations CVC**.
* Solides connaissances techniques en chauffage, ventilation et/ou climatisation.
* Bonnes capacités d'analyse et de diagnostic de pannes.
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités.
* Esprit d'équipe et bon relationnel.
* Sensibilité élevée aux questions de sécurité.
* Permis de conduire **catégorie B**.
* Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, énergétique ou technique complexe constitue un atout.

jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Consultant technico-fonctionnel Salesforce - H/F --- Consultant technico\\-fonctionnel Salesforce \\- H/F ================================================== Membre du groupe Sigmalis, actif depuis 2007 dans le conseil et l'ingénierie en informatique, Sigmalis Talent Services accompagne les entreprises dans l'identification et l'attraction d'experts IT et de cadres, en proposant une offre complète en recrutement: placement fixe, délégation en régie, mission temporaire et executive search. Notre expertise en recrutement depuis plus de 20 ans en Suisse Romande, associée à une compréhension approfondie des métiers technologiques et des enjeux RH, nous permet de vous proposer des opportunités pertinentes dans des environnements professionnels réellement adaptés à vos attentes. Notre priorité est d'assurer votre réussite sur le long terme, que vous soyez en recherche d'un poste fixe chez un client ou comme consultant au sein de notre équipe. ### Description du poste Dans le cadre d'une mission auprès de l'un de nos clients, nous recherchons un(e) \*\*Consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) et technique Salesforce\*\* disposant d'une expertise confirmée sur \*\*Salesforce Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud\*\*. \*\*Le taux d'activité est de 50%.\*\* Vous interviendrez dans un environnement où Salesforce occupe une place centrale dans la gestion de la relation client, avec pour objectif d'optimiser les processus, d'améliorer la personnalisation des interactions et de renforcer l'automatisation des campagnes marketing. Vos missions ------------ Vous intervenez à la fois sur les dimensions \*\*fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles\*\* des plateformes Salesforce. ### Salesforce Marketing Cloud Vous serez en charge de : \* mettre en place et optimiser la segmentation des audiences, \* concevoir et automatiser les campagnes marketing : journeys, triggers, requêtes SQL, \* créer et adapter des templates de newsletters, \* développer des modèles de reporting permettant de mesurer la performance des campagnes, \* assurer les intégrations avec le CRM et les autres systèmes internes. ### Salesforce Sales Cloud Vous contribuerez à : \* l'implémentation et l'optimisation de workflows automatisés, \* la création et la configuration de champs techniques et d'objets, \* la personnalisation des tableaux de bord et du reporting, \* l'optimisation du pipeline commercial, \* l'intégration de Sales Cloud avec des systèmes externes, notamment via API. Support et accompagnement des utilisateurs ------------------------------------------ Vous assurez également un rôle de référent fonctionnel et technique auprès des équipes : \* support sur Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud, \* accompagnement dans l'utilisation quotidienne des segments, workflows, dashboards et campagnes, \* formation des équipes internes afin de renforcer progressivement leur autonomie. Amélioration continue et gouvernance ------------------------------------- Vous participez activement à l'optimisation et à la gouvernance des plateformes Salesforce : \* audit régulier des environnements Marketing Cloud et Sales Cloud, \* analyse et nettoyage des segments, doublons et workflows devenus obsolètes, \* définition et mise à jour des bonnes pratiques d'administration, \* mise en place de conventions de nommage, règles d'archivage et standards documentaires, \* proposition d'améliorations fonctionnelles, techniques et organisationnelles, \* recueil et clarification des besoins métiers, \* animation d'ateliers avec les équipes internes, \* rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, \* définition et suivi de la gouvernance Salesforce, \* prise en compte des exigences de conformité \*\*GDPR et LIPAD\*\*. Gestion des évolutions et des environnements --------------------------------------------- Dans le cadre des différents projets Salesforce, vous assurez également : \* le suivi des évolutions et nouvelles implémentations, \* la gestion du cycle de vie des environnements, notamment de la sandbox vers la production, \* la mise en place et la supervision des processus de sauvegarde et de restauration ; \* la documentation systématique des changements, \* le suivi et le reporting de l'avancement des travaux. ### Profil recherché Vous êtes titulaire d'un \*\*Bachelor dans le domaine informatique ou d'une formation équivalente\*\*. Vous disposez d'une expertise confirmée sur \*\*Salesforce Marketing Cloud\*\*, notamment sur : \* Automation Studio \* Journey Builder \* Email Studio \* SQL Query \* intégrations API. Vous possédez également une solide expérience de \*\*Salesforce Sales Cloud\*\*, incluant notamment : \* Process Builder / Flows \* champs personnalisés \* objets Salesforce \* dashboards \* reporting. Une expérience dans l'intégration de Salesforce avec des sites web, CRM et autres systèmes via API est attendue. Vous maîtrisez également les principes de gouvernance Salesforce, l'analyse de données marketing et les bonnes pratiques en matière de sécurité et de conformité GDPR/LIPAD. Compétences fonctionnelles --------------------------- Une bonne compréhension des environnements métiers suivants est recherchée : \* marketing et web\\-marketing \* e\\-commerce \* commerce lié au transport de voyageurs \* retail et ventes en boutique. \*\*Les certifications Salesforce suivantes constituent un atout.\*\* Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil, nous recevrons avec plaisir votre candidature qui doit comprendre \*\*votre cv ainsi que votre dossier complet (copies de diplômes, certificats de travail, etc...).\*\* ### Les conditions salariales ### \*\*Ce que Sigmalis vous offre\*\* Un plan de prévoyance (LPP) particulièrement avantageux Une prime variable annuelle liée à la performance individuelle et aux résultats de l'entreprise La possibilité d'être en télétravail jusqu'à 40 % et de prendre des vacances sans solde sous réserve d'accord client Des avantages spécifiques selon la mission (abonnement de transport public, formation, etc.). Senior Specialist, IT  
Senior Specialist, IT  
Place of work: Basel, Switzerland  
Employment rate: 50–100%  
Start date: 1 January 2027 or sooner  
Contract type: Permanent  
Other: Must be eligible to work in Switzerland  
Basel Institute on Governance  
The Basel Institute on Governance is a hands\-on centre of competence dedicated to promoting good governance and countering corruption for a more peaceful, just and sustainable world. Established in 2003 in Basel, Switzerland, the Institute works with partners worldwide to advance knowledge, practice and policy on anti\-corruption, asset recovery and business integrity. With field operations worldwide, it has some 150 staff covering 32 nationalities. The Basel Institute is an Associated Institute of the University of Basel.  
Job description  
The Senior Specialist, IT takes operational ownership of the Basel Institute’s IT infrastructure, security and identity management. Working closely with and deputising for the Head, IT and eLearning, the successful candidate will keep the Basel Institute’s systems secure, available and well\-documented, lead the day\-to\-day implementation of the IT Security and Operations Policy and help with the safe and effective adoption of new technologies, including AI. The Senior Specialist will also supervise and develop the Associate, IT.  
Key responsibilities  
Implement, maintain and monitor the Basel Institute’s IT Security and Operations Policy and support the disaster recovery and malware response plans.  
Maintain and monitor the IT infrastructure, including the Sophos firewall appliance, UniFi wireless network, Xerox printers, 3CX phone system, Synology NAS devices and the NextCloud shared drive.  
Manage users, authentication and access rights across Active Directory and Google Workspace, including onboarding and offboarding and regular access reviews.  
Provide and coordinate cybersecurity awareness training for staff, including onboarding and regular refresher training and act as a point of contact for reporting and responding to security incidents.  
Identify, evaluate and implement AI tools and solutions to improve IT operations and support their safe, compliant and well\-governed adoption across the Basel Institute.  
Supervise, mentor and develop the Associate, IT, coordinating day\-to\-day support and workload.  
Oversee IT asset management, backups and system monitoring, coordinate with external service providers and deputise for the Head, IT and eLearning as required.  
Provide first\-level IT support to staff alongside the Associate, IT, ensuring timely resolution and acting as the escalation point for more complex issues.  
Qualifications and skills  
University degree or equivalent vocational qualification in information technology, computer science or a related field.  
At least five years of experience in IT systems administration and infrastructure, ideally in a mixed on\-premises and cloud environment.  
Proven expertise in network and firewall administration (Sophos experience is an advantage), identity and access management (Active Directory, Google Workspace) as well as IT security.  
Relevant experience with UniFi Wi\-Fi, Synology NAS, NextCloud, 3CX telephony and remote management/monitoring tools, as well as experience supervising or mentoring colleagues, is an advantage.  
Proficient in Microsoft and Google Workspace administration.  
Experience in a major AI platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and the creation and management of skills, plugins, connectors, agents and MCP servers.  
Languages: Excellent English skills; a good command of German and proficiency in other languages are an advantage.  
Offer  
We offer an interesting and rewarding working environment with a proactive, dynamic and international team spirit. The work is both routine and varied, and offers scope for initiative and innovation. The salary is competitive.

Global Head of Education (f/m/d)
================================

### **About the ITI**

The ITI (International Team for Implantology) is the world's leading academic community in implant dentistry. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, we are an independent, non\-profit, member\-led organization uniting around 25,000 Fellows and Members across 40 Sections worldwide.

Built on four pillars — Science, Education, Leadership and Membership — the ITI sets the global standard for evidence\-based education and has invested heavily in research that improves treatment for patients everywhere. Our purpose is simple: *inspiring global excellence in implant dentistry for the benefit of the patient.*

### **The opportunity**

Are you ready to shape how the world learns implant dentistry? As Global Head of Education, you will own the ITI's education strategy and — in a small, entrepreneurial team — build and deliver it personally. This is a senior leadership role for someone who is equal parts strategist, builder and doer: you will set the direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it happen, every day.

You will keep the ITI the leading global authority in implant dentistry education, scale our education business and partner ecosystem across university\-based and private education, and grow the number of clinicians educated to the ITI Curriculum standard. You will also guide and support the high\-profile volunteers of the global ITI Education Committee, co\-creating strategy and content priorities with dentists and academics from dental schools and private practice alike.

### **What you will do**

**Strategy \& portfolio — own it and build it**

* **Set the direction.** Develop and deliver the global education strategy across university\-based and private education, aligned with the ITI's mission and growth goals.
* **Own the full portfolio, hands\-on.** ITI Curriculum, University Program, Treatment Guides, ITI Academy, study\-club and partner content, congress and course content.
* **Expand undergraduate education.** Lead train\-the\-trainer programs and a stronger service offering for universities.
* **Grow the partner ecosystem.** Build and roll out a partnership program for private education providers to spread ITI content and standards.


**Committee, volunteers \& stakeholders**

* **Be a trusted advisor.** Act as sparring partner to the Education Committee and its Chair; prepare decisions and co\-create direction with these high\-profile volunteers.
* **Energize the network.** Motivate and coordinate \~40 education volunteers worldwide who drive education in local Sections and countries.
* **Connect across the ecosystem.** Work closely with education colleagues in subsidiaries and Sections, and with KOLs, universities, providers and industry partners — including Straumann.
* **Represent the ITI.** At congresses, universities, partner meetings and scientific events.


**Content \& learning — personally in the detail**

* **Run the editorial engine.** Own the end\-to\-end process for educational content: editorial, video, e\-learning, presentations, courses and events.
* **Raise the bar on learning.** Drive quality and consistency across in\-person, blended and digital formats, and strengthen learning design and outcome measurement.
* **Grow the ITI Academy.** Develop our digital channels to increase reach, engagement and active usage, and shape the agendas of congresses and study clubs.


**Operations, budget \& performance**

* **Keep operations running.** Own the underlying processes — editorial, course management, partner management and governance.
* **Hold the numbers.** Full budget responsibility for the portfolio (top and bottom line); develop and recommend the budget to the CEO, and own pricing and partner models.
* **Track what matters.** Define and report on KPIs — learners and graduates, education touchpoints, active partners, active platform users and CSAT.
* **Lead the team.** Build and develop a small, hands\-on, entrepreneurial and results\-oriented education team.


### **What you bring**

* **Experience.** Min. 10 years in professional education in healthcare (corporate or comparable not\-for\-profit), with min. 5 years leading people in complex, global, matrixed organizations.
* **A track record of results.** Driving learner growth, engagement or partner impact through education — with hands\-on experience producing content and running programs, not only overseeing them.
* **Domain depth.** Dentistry or medical devices preferred; digital learning, university partnerships or professional societies a strong plus. Experience building education partner ecosystems is valued.
* **Strategic and entrepreneurial instincts.** The business acumen to build education models and sustainable portfolios, and the bias to action to turn vision into scalable execution.
* **Stakeholder confidence.** Diplomatic, persuasive communication with executives, scientific experts, volunteers, universities and industry partners across cultures.
* **Craft and judgement.** A solid grasp of learning design, digital/blended learning and outcome measurement, plus strong editorial judgement on scientific, medical and educational content.
* **Education \& languages.** Bachelor's or equivalent in business, education, dentistry, healthcare, life sciences or a related field. Fluent English (further languages an advantage); willingness to travel \~20%.


### **What we offer**

The chance to shape implant dentistry globally, alongside leading minds in the field, for the benefit of patients worldwide.A prestigious organization with 45\+ years in implant dentistry education and research, and a community of tens of thousands of space to create and shape, where ideas and opinions are truly hierarchies and a people\-centric, entrepreneurial , long\-term industry partners that provide stability and broader career perspectives.

### How to apply

We only accept direct applications submitted either through the application portal of this jobs platform or our own application portal. Use the following link to submit your application through the ITI portal:

[ITI Application Portal](<>)

We do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.



 **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.

* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.

Flexsis is a company of the Interiman Group, one of the leading providers of personnel services in Switzerland. Thanks to our solid expertise as well as the competencies within the Interiman Group, we offer tailored solutions in personnel consulting.

**Tech Transfer Operations Lead**

* Lead technical transfers for combination products, medical devices, device assembly, and secondary packaging from development through commercial manufacturing.
* Develop and execute technical transfer strategies in collaboration with NTO and global cross\-functional partners.
* Drive harmonization and standardization of manufacturing processes, technical approaches, and documentation across sites.
* Act as Technical Transfer Lead (TTL) for selected device and secondary packaging transfer and launch projects.

* Bring your technical and manufacturing expertise into device development, commercialization, and product lifecycle management activities.
* Support design control and the development of robust, scalable assembly and packaging processes.

jobs.title: Core designer
jobs.description:
What we do at Blykalla

Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.

What you’ll get to do

We're seeking an senior core designer or core design methods developer to join our Nuclear Engineering & Safety team in Stockholm. In this role, you will design and analyze fast reactor core configurations, optimize fuel loading patterns, develop associated methods and contribute to safe, efficient, and economical operation of our nuclear reactors throughout their fuel cycles.

    Design and optimize reactor core variants for our cutting-edge lead-cooled fast reactor designs
    Perform neutronic and burn-up analysis using both industry-standard and new codes
    Develop and validate core design models and methodologies
    Prepare technical documentation, design reports, and licensing submittals for regulatory review
    Stay current with advances in core design, computational methods, and regulatory requirements

Who’ll you’ll get to work with

The senior core designer sits in the Nuclear engineering & safety team within Blykalla, and reports to the head of Nuclear engineering & safety. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and our company.

Who you are

You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:

    Master's degree in nuclear engineering, physics, or a related field
    At least 5 years of industry experience in reactor core design, reactor physics, neutronics, fuel management, or associated methods development including verification & validation of computational tools
    Proficiency with Monte Carlo neutron transport codes and experience setting up and running full-core or assembly-level models
    Familiarity with the full core design workflow including cross-section generation, uncertainty propagation, depletion analysis and burnup-dependent reactivity feedback characterization
    Strong understanding of reactor physics, thermal hydraulics, and fuel performance
    Familiarity with relevant regulatory frameworks
    Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills
    Fluency in English, spoken and written

Meritorious skills:

    Programming skills, e.g. in Python, Fortran, or MATLAB
    Fluency in Swedish, spoken and written

If you are not sure that you are 100% qualified, but are up to the challenge, we encourage you to apply.

Location

This position is for our office in Stockholm.

So, what do you think?

Joining our team means being part of a supportive and innovative environment where your ideas are valued and your expertise is recognized. You will have the opportunity to work with industry leaders and contribute to the safe and sustainable use of nuclear power.

We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!

Reference & Background Checks

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.

Salary Range: SEK 57 000 – 76 000/ month, depending on experience and qualifications.

We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.

We do not accept applications via email.

We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.

Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Enterprise Data & Systems Architect 100%
jobs.description:
Are you a systems architect or senior engineer who has built the digital backbone of a manufacturing or high-tech company, ready to own it end-to-end? At Lightium, we are building next-generation photonic integrated circuits (PICs) based on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and we are looking for an Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to become the technical backbone of our data platform and enterprise systems.

Position Summary
We seek a hands-on Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to own the technical architecture of our data infrastructure, automation and digital systems. The ownership spans from database architecture and data warehouse to PLM, ERP and MES systems, as well as test automation, serving both R&D and growing production flow. As part of the Operations team, you will drive the data and systems strategy, own the integration between tools and data infrastructure, keeping the landscape coherent and lean as we scale from pilot to volume production. You will be managing and mentoring a small team of specialists ranging from DevOps to Data Scientists and Automation Engineers.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Systems Architecture & Strategy: Own the architecture and roadmap for Lightium’s data platform, enterprise systems, and supporting infrastructure as we scale from pilot to volume. Ensure that decisions across the data warehouse, PLM, ERP, MES, and HW/SW infrastructure reinforce one another rather than compete, and translate manufacturing and business needs into a coherent, pragmatic systems strategy that ensures data traceability across the company and across multiple locations and departments. Build and maintain high level dashboards that allows both operations and leadership teams to track KPI. Be responsible for all the cloud computing and cloud storage solutions, including Azure, AWS, Google Computing (GC) to ensure a cost-effective and scalable operations for both simulations, data analysis and data storage.

Data & Analytics Platform: Own the database and data-warehouse architecture and the modeling of test and manufacturing data, scaling it to support higher production volumes. Design, build, and operate the databases, data pipelines, transformation and orchestration, and lakehouse behind it on a modern data stack. Set the data contracts, naming conventions, and quality standards that keep data trustworthy and traceable as volume grows, and ensure the platform powers reliable analytics, BI, reporting, and internal tools at scale.

Data Security, Governance & Compliance: Own IT and data security and governance across the platform: access control (including external and internal Tier-based access), managing data encryption in transit and at rest, backups and disaster recovery, and clear ownership of who can access what. Align the systems and data landscape with the relevant standards (ISO 9001 quality management and ISO/IEC 27001 information security) and design the access and data-segregation controls that ensures confidentiality, and support export-control compliance (ITAR, US EAR, and the Swiss Goods Control Act / dual-use regulations) when handling sensitive PIC technical data.

Enterprise Systems & Product Lifecycle: Own Aras Innovator (PLM) and the ERP (Oracle NetSuite) implementation, including ongoing rollout, configuration, and the integration between the two. Drive end-to-end product and document lifecycle traceability, from design through to manufacturing, measurements, reporting and shipment, and keep master data consistent and clean across systems.

MES Selection & Implementation: Scout the market for a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform that fits both R&D (with high flexibility) and production (with high scalability), and run the full supplier tender through to vendor selection. Lead the subsequent implementation and integration of the MES with PLM, ERP, and the data platform, so that process steps, run data, and traceability flow end-to-end as production scales.

Test Automation & Tool Integration: Own the automated wafer-scale test software built on OpenTAP, from architecture and build through production rollout. Define and maintain the data-exchange protocols between tools and systems, connecting PLM, ERP, test, MES, and the data warehouse, and partner with process and test engineering to keep automation reliable and scalable as production volume ramps.

Infrastructure, Vendors & Continuous Improvement: Own the reliability, security, and scaling of core infrastructure (Linux servers, virtualization, containerized services, object storage, and backups), from the lakehouse and storage layers to application hosting and manufacturing-adjacent systems, and manage projects, contracts, and SLAs with external IT vendors and managed-service providers. Document architecture as living references, support the colleagues who use the systems day to day, and continuously improve how data and digital tools serve the company.

Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Act as the technical reference and architect for the wider engineering community, setting the direction, standards, and best practices that automation engineers, data and analytics engineers, DevOps engineers, and interns. Manage and mentor a small team of specialists, and guide them in their day-to-day work, and support the hiring process for these roles as the team grows around the architecture you define.

What You’ll Bring
Educational Background: A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field, with a strong track record in enterprise or solutions architecture, ideally in a manufacturing or semiconductor environment. You have ideally designed and built enterprise systems architectures from scratch.

Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with PLM (Aras Innovator or similar) and ERP systems, including their implementation and integration. A track record leading automated/robotic production or testing lines, preferably in a semiconductor industry or similar. A strong database and data-engineering background (database and data-model design, data pipelines, transformation and orchestration, and data quality), hands-on with modern lakehouse and data platforms such as Databricks, Apache Iceberg, and Trino, and comfortable across both cloud and on-prem infrastructure, including containers, object storage, and lakehouse architectures. A solid grasp of data security, encryption, backups, and access control. Vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating SLAs with managed-service providers. Familiarity with data-relevant standards (ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001) and export-control regimes (ITAR, US EAR, Swiss dual-use / Goods Control Act) is a strong asset. Proficiency in modern AI solutions.

Mindset: Pragmatic and lean by instinct, happy to architect and to build with your own hands, and to solve problems through smart integration and vendor orchestration rather than headcount. People-leadership experience, with a track record of hiring, managing and mentoring technical staff. A strong communicator, able to translate manufacturing and business needs into technical strategy for executive leadership, and at home in a fast-moving startup.

Languages: Fluency in English is required. German or French is a bonus.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including an employee stock option plan (ESOP), fully-covered Pillar Two, and generous vacation.

A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics.

A collaborative and innovative work environment where your contributions will shape the future of telecommunications, datacom, and beyond.

Final Thoughts
We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and result-driven environment. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and join a motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: SiS ungdomshem Stigby söker idrottslärare
jobs.description:
Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk. SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring.

SiS ungdomshem Stigby på Visingsö har plats för 35 ungdomar och tar emot icke skolpliktiga pojkar med psykosocial problematik, kriminalitet och missbruk. Vi är uppdelad på en MBB-avdelning (mottagning- och behovsbedömning), fyra behandlingsavdelningar och en utskrivningsförberedande avdelning i Jönköping.

Arbetsbeskrivning

SiS ungdomshem Stigbys skolverksamhet erbjuder undervisning för 35 ungdomar. Eleverna studerar inom introduktionsprogrammet. De erbjuds grundskoleämnen, olika gymnasieämnen samt yrkesinriktad praktisk utbildning med inslag från arbetslivet i form av APL. Det finns fyra yrkesprogram: industri, bygg, fordon och transport samt restaurang- och livsmedelsprogrammet. Därtill har vi en fotbollsinriktning vilket innebär ett nära samarbete med öns fotbollsklubb då fotboll är ett viktigt inslag i både skola och behandlingsverksamhet. Undervisningen sker i små grupper. Skolverksamheten är en mycket viktig framgångsfaktor inom institutionsvården och den största skyddsfaktorn för våra ungdomar.

Ditt uppdrag innebär att undervisa inom idrott och hälsa i gymnasieskolan men även bedriva undervisning på grundskolenivå, då många av våra elever inte har slutbetyg från grundskolan. I arbetet ingår även att organisera och skapa förutsättningar för Stigbys fritidsaktiviteter och fotbollsprofil genom att planera, samverka med föreningar och att driva utvecklingsfrågor i fritidsverksamheten. För att lyckas med ditt läraruppdrag krävs det att du kan bygga relationer med dina elever - det är utgångspunkten i vårt arbete som leder till att eleverna utvecklar sitt lärande och sina förmågor. Din personliga lämplighet är nyckeln till livsviktig förändring. Därför behöver du vara en varm empatisk person som drivs av en stark inre glöd och vilja att skapa resultat utöver det vanliga. Att du är en kollega som delar kunskap och bidrar till vi-känslan på SiS är andra egenskaper som gör dig intressant. Lika viktigt är det att du har en grundmurad positiv människosyn och en förmåga att hantera konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Vi arbetar i arbetslag där vi förväntar oss att du bidrar med dina kunskaper, lärdomar och där kollegialt lärande är en naturlig del i ditt läraruppdrag. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar tillsammans för en positiv arbetsmiljö och där allas idéer respekteras och välkomnas.

Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid.

Kvalifikationer

Vi i första hand dig som har idrottslärarlegitimation och behörighet att undervisa på gymnasienivå. Vi välkomnar även dig som har idrottslärarlegitimation för år 7-9.

Följande kvalifikationer önskar vi att du har:

    En god elevsyn - där alla människors lika värde är en självklarhet och att du har en kulturell medvetenhet.
    Pedagogisk insikt- där du är flexibel i ditt tänk, kreativ och arbetar gärna tematisk och ämnesövergripande.
    Relationsskapande och har en empatisk förmåga då du inser att relation är grunden till elevens lärande och utveckling.
    Har samarbetsförmåga samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och ta egna initiativ
    Du är stabil, har en personlig mognad, integritet och är tydlig.
    Uthållig- du ger inte upp i första taget utan tror på eleven och dess förmågor att lyckas i sitt lärande.
    Att du kan fotboll - där fotbollen är Stigbys profil och samarbete med öns fotbollslag samt andra föreningar är en viktig del i detta.

Meriterande är behörighet i andra ämnen samt specialpedagogisk utbildning. Har du tidigare arbetat inom ungdomsvården så välkomnar vi det.

Körkort- B är ett krav.

På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.

Anställning:

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid och inleds med sex månaders provanställning.

Tillträde: 2026-12-01 eller enligt överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Motor Technician
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Ventside Unlimited Company T/A Frank Keane Volkswagen are Dublin’s largest Volkswagen retailer, Liffey Valley Motor Mall, Dublin 22, D22 T322, with showrooms and Aftersales facilities that have been equipped and developed to the very latest Volkswagen standards. As a result of significant operation expansions, we are now recruiting for career-oriented Qualified & Part-Qualified Motor Technicians to join our Dublin team. The Role: The ideal candidates will be experienced in all aspects of vehicle servicing and diagnostics and be capable of producing quality work in a busy environment. Responsibilities include: • Performing work as outlined on the job card with efficiency and accuracy, in accordance with Volkswagen retailer standards. • Communicating with parts department to obtain needed parts, inform workshop manager if vehicle is awaiting parts and pursue special order of parts if necessary. • Diagnosing cause of any malfunction and perform repair after confirming authorization by customer. • Saving and tagging any and all parts if the job is under warranty or if requested by customer. • Examining the vehicle and performing vehicle health checks to determine if additional safety or service work is required. • Notifying service advisors immediately if additional work is needed, if work outlined is not needed, or if repairs can not be completed within the time promised. • Road-testing vehicles to spot check work performed. • Keeping abreast of Volkswagen technical bulletins and attend factory sponsored training classes. • Maintaining a clean and neat workspace and adhering to all company policies, procedures and safety standards Requirements: • Qualified Technician - a minimum of 3 years post apprenticeship experience - ideally working with the Volkswagen brand. • Ability to clearly complete job card write ups with a thorough understanding of the requirements of factory standards for warranty write-ups. • Good communication skills and the ability to identify and explain additional work required to service advisors or customers as required. • Previous experience working with ADP/Kerridge environment would be an advantage. Only applicants with a suitable work visa should apply. Remuneration: €40,000 - €60,000 per year, based on a 40 hour working week
