jobs.title: Arbetskonsulent
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och stärka människors väg mot arbetsmarknaden? Nu söker vi en engagerad arbetskonsulent till Jobbcentrum inom Socialförvaltningen.

Jobbcentrum arbetar med arbetsmarknadsinsatser för vuxna som står långt från arbetsmarknaden. Vi möter deltagare med varierande bakgrund och utmaningar, exempelvis kort utbildning, ohälsa, funktionsnedsättning eller begränsade svenskkunskaper. Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med interna och externa aktörer såsom försörjningsstöd, Arbetsförmedlingen, Försäkringskassan och arbetsgivare i både privat och offentlig sektor.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som arbetskonsulent ansvarar du för en egen deltagargrupp och arbetar strukturerat för att stärka individens möjligheter till arbete eller studier.

I tjänsten gör du följande:

    • Kartlägger deltagarens situation, resurser, förutsättningar och hinder för att skapa en tydlig bild av vilka insatser som behövs.
    • Upprättar individuella genomförandeplaner, följer upp progression och justerar insatser vid behov.
    • Genomför vägledande, stödjande och motiverande samtal där du coachar deltagare mot ökad självständighet och närmare arbetsmarknaden.
    • Planerar, initierar och följer upp aktiviteter, såsom praktik, arbetsträning, studieförberedande insatser eller andra stödformer.
    • Bygger och upprätthåller kontakter med arbetsgivare, matchar deltagare mot arbetsplatser och följer upp placeringar.
    • Samordnar insatser tillsammans med andra aktörer och leder flerpartssamtal där flera myndigheter eller parter ingår.
    • Följer upp deltagarens utveckling och arbetsförmåga i relation till planerade aktiviteter och tillsammans med deltagaren identifierar lämpliga nästa steg.
    • Dokumenterar löpande i Lifecare Arbetsmarknad och hanterar administrativt underlag kopplat till deltagarna.
    • Bidrar till utveckling av arbetssätt och aktiviteter tillsammans med kollegor och är delaktig i det dagliga förbättringsarbetet.

Här får du ett varierat och meningsfullt arbete där du gör verklig skillnad i människors liv.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har ett professionellt bemötande, god förmåga att skapa tillit och en stark tro på människors förmåga att utvecklas. Du är stabil, lösningsfokuserad och trygg i både självständigt arbete och teamwork.

Krav

    • Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller likvärdig erfarenhet.
    • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer som står långt från arbetsmarknaden.
    • B-körkort.

Meriterande

    • Erfarenhet av arbetslivsinriktad rehabilitering.
    • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer med ohälsa eller nedsatt arbetsförmåga.
    • Erfarenhet av arbetsträning eller andra arbetslivsinriktade insatser.
    • Språkkunskaper i exempelvis arabiska, somaliska eller tigrinja.
    • Erfarenhet av etableringsarbete för utomeuropeiskt födda.
    • Erfarenhet av arbete med personer med funktionsnedsättning.
    • Erfarenhet av evidensbaserade metoder inom arbetsmarknadsområdet.

Personlig lämplighet har stor betydelse i denna rekrytering.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Det är av yttersta vikt att kunder och klienter inom socialförvaltningens verksamheter kan känna trygghet i den omsorg som kommunen har ansvar för. Därför måste du visa upp ett utdrag från belastningsregistret innan erbjudande om anställning. Handläggningstiden för ett utdrag är cirka tre veckor och du beställer det själv via polisens webbplats. Beställ gärna utdraget samtidigt som du skickar in din ansökan så att du har allting klart om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Utdraget ska vara oöppnat och inte äldre än 6 månader.

Beställ ditt utdrag från belastningsregistret på polisens webbplats här:

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/kontrollera-dina-uppgifter-i-belastningsregistret/

Vi använder verksamhetssystemet Life Care. Av säkerhetsskäl kräver Life Care att alla som använder systemet loggar in med e-legitimationen Freja eID+. För att du som anställd ska kunna använda systemet behöver du skaffa Freja eID+. Du får mer information vid en eventuell intervju.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt via länken för ansökan.

Dina ansökningshandlingar omfattas av offentlighetsprincipen och kan därför komma att lämnas ut som allmän handling efter en sekretessprövning. Vill du veta mer om hur Enköpings kommun generellt sett hanterar personuppgifter så finns mer information på vår hemsida.

För dig som har skyddad identitet så finns information om hur du söker tjänsten här:

https://enkoping.se/underwebbar/jobb-och-karriar-i-enkoping/jobba-hos-oss/var-rekryteringsprocess.html

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

jobs.title: Specialiseret butiksmedarbejder/knivspecialist. Specialist retail assistent - Japanese as working language
jobs.description:
Arbejdssted: København Location: Copenhagen

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 37 timer om ugen. Working hours. Full-time, 37 hours per week.

Ansættelsesform: Fastansættelse Employment: Permanent position.

Om stillingen:

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder til vores specialiserede butik med fokus på japanske kvalitetsknive og japansk knivhåndværk.

Stillingen er en kombination af salg og kundeservice, arbejde med slibning af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen kombinerer salg og kundeservice med praktisk arbejde, slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive samt løbende kontakt med vores japanske leverandører og samarbejdspartnere.

En væsentlig del af stillingen indebærer direkte kommunikation med japanske producenter og leverandører. Derfor er gode japanske sprogkundskaber en nødvendighed kompetence i stillingen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Salg og rådgivning af kunder om japanske kvalitetsknive og tilbehør.

Kundeservice og vejledning om valg, brug og vedligeholdelse af knive.

Slibning og vedligeholdelse af knive, samt indgravering i hånden.

Modtagelse, kontrol og håndtering af varer.

Vare- og lagerstyring.

Kommunikation med japanske leverandører og producenter,

Håndtering af profuktinformation, ordrer, specifikationer og leverancer.

Oversættelse og videreformidling af information mellem virksomheden og japanske leverandører.

Bidrage til den daglige drift og præsentation af butikken.

Vi forventer, at du:

Taler og skriver japansk på højt niveau.

Kan kommunikere proffesionelt med vores japanske leverandører både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Har interesse for japanske knive, håndværk og kvalitet.

Har gode kundeservice- og salgsevner.

Er omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst.

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

Har interesse for eller erfaring med knivslibning.

Behersker engelsk, så du kan kommunikere med kolleger og kunder.

Erfaring med knivslibning, salg eller arbejde med japanske knive er en fordel. Erfaring med håndgravering er ligeledes en fordel. Oplæring i virksomhedens produkter og arbejdsmetoder vil blive givet efter behov.

Japansk er et nødvendigt arbejdssprog, da medarbejderne vil have løbende kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører, vedrørende blandt andet produktinformation, bestillinger, specifikationer og leverancer.

Vi tilbyder:

Fast ansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

En alsidig stilling i en specialiseret butik.

Arbejde med japanske kvalitetsprodukter og knivhåndværk.

Direkte kontakt med japanske producenter og leverandører.

Oplæring i produkter, knivtyper og slibeteknikker.

Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og god kundeservice.

Løn: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning:

Send CV og ansøgning til tess@foodgear.dk.

Fortæl gerne om din baggrund og erfaring med japansk håndværk, samt dine sprogkundskaber.

Regarding the position:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded employee to join our specialized shop, focusing on high quality Japanese knives and Japanese knife craftmanship.

The position combines sales and customer service with practical work, involving knife sharpening and maintenance, as well as ongoing communication with our Japanese suppliers and business partners.

A significant part of the postion involves direct communication with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers. Therefore, a high level of Japanese language proficiency is an essential requirement for the position.

Your responsibilities:

Selling and advising customers on Japanese high quality knives and accessories.

Providing customer service andguidance on the selection, use and maintenance of knives.

Knife sharpening, maintenance and hand engraving.

Receiving, checking and handling goods.

Stock and inventory management.

Communication with Japanese suppliers and manufacturers.

Handling product information, orders, specifications and deliveries.

Translating and communicating information between the company and Japanese business partners.

Contributing to the day-to-day operation and presentation of the shop.

We expect you to:

Speak and write Japanese at a high level.

Be able to communicate professionally with Japanese suppliers, both verbally and in writing.

Have an interest in Japanese knives, craftmanship and quality.

Have good customer service and sales skills.

Be detail oriented and quality conscious.

Be able to work independently and take responsibility.

Have an interest in or experience with knife sharpening.

Have a good command of English for communication with colleagues and customers.

Experience in sales, knife sharpening or working with Japaneseknives is an advantage. Experience with hand engraving of knives is also an advantage. Training in the companys products and working methods will be provided as required.

Japanese is an essential working language, as the employee will have regular contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers regarding product information, orders, specifikations, deliveries and other matters related to our Japanese products.

We offer:

A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week.

A varied position in a specialised retail shop.

The opportunity to work with high-quality Japanese products and traditional knife craftmanship.

Direct contact with Japanese manufacturers and suppliers.

Training in products, knife types and sharpening techniques.

A working environment focused on quality, expertise and excellent customer service.

Salary: Salary and employment terms according to qualifications and experience.

How to apply: Please send an email with your CV and application to tess@foodgear.dk

Please include information about your experience with Japanese products, knives, sales, customer service as well as your Japanese and English skills.

jobs.title: Waitress
jobs.description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

jobs.title: WISE Fellow: Assistant professor in Materials Science
jobs.description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!



For more information about the vacancy

https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/vacancies/29904

Work assignments

This Assistant Professorship focuses on research in the field of inorganic materials with the aim of developing and advancing sustainable materials and technologies for quantum technologies. A particular focus is on experimental activities related to controlled growth (synthesis) and advanced materials characterization focused towards properties. Placement will be at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Biology (IFM) at Linköping University.

Key research areas and responsibilities include one or several of the following:

    Materials synthesis Advance current activities on CVD-growth of wide-bandgap semiconductors and 2D materials, or establish activities on materials and processes beyond current activities, for development of solid-state quantum technology.
    Materials characterization Investigate the electronic, optical, and magnetic (including magneto-optical) properties of materials (qubits).
    Device fabrication Use materials as qubits in quantum computing and related fields, single photon emitters for secure quantum communications, and beyond.

With the help of a very competitive start-up package including funding for two PhD students, two postdocs, and own salary; state-of-the art facilities; and an environment characterized by strong internal and international collaboration, the applicant is expected to establish and maintain an  independent research program in inorganic materials for quantum technologies which complements and expands IFM’s current research activities.

At Linköping university, the current development of solid-state quantum technology is facilitated by our leading international role in material growth of wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC, GaN, AlGaN and Ga2O3) and two-dimensional materials. In cooperation between the experimental and theoretical divisions, we currently seek new defects in wide bandgap materials with properties suitable for quantum technology. Further, we have strong collaborations with groups at the department of Electrical Engineering at LiU which cover a broad spectrum of research on Quantum communication, Quantum information and Quantum foundations.

For all work assignments, see link above!

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who have a doctoral degree or equivalent scientific competence. We are primarily looking for candidates who have obtained their doctoral degree in the past 7 years, but applications are welcome from candidates who obtained their degree  more than 7 years ago.

For this employment, special emphasis is placed on academic proficiency, and secondary emphasis placed on proficiencies in specific areas of expertise (below).

In terms of academic expertise, the following will be assessed:

    Requirements for the position is previous expertise and a proposed research program that complement and expand IFM’s current research activities related to Materials for Quantum Technologies
    Requirements for the position is a PhD degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Applied Physics, or other relevant field
    Requirements for the position is Postdoctoral or equivalent experience of relevance
    Of particular merit is experience leading research project(s)
    Of particular merit is experience in writing and publishing high quality/high impact scientific articles, especially as lead or corresponding/last author
    Of merit for the position is experience in taking part in and coordinating national or international research activities
    Of merit for the position is previous awarded research grants as (ideally) main or co-applicant
    Of merit for the position is previous experience coordinating research grants

In terms of pedagogical expertise, the following will be assessed:

    Of particular merit for the position is previous experience in guiding masters students, PhD students, and/or postdoctoral researchers
    Of merit for the position is previous experience in teaching at master students level or PhD courses
    Of merit for the position is previous experience in course planning and development of course material

Of additional merit for the position is:

    Documented expertise in collaboration in research
    Experience working in a large, internally-collaborative research group
    Experience from establishing new lab activities, setting up new equipment

Since teaching and research are conducted in English, you must be able to demonstrate the ability to teach and conduct research in English.

The workplace

You can read about the the workplace https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm.

The employment

This position is subject to a period of employment of 4 years, fulltime.

Starting date by agreement.

For more information on eligibility requirements, assessment criteria and recruitment procedures for teachers, see Linköping University´s rules of appointment https://styrdokument.liu.se/Regelsamling/VisaBeslut/622784.

Salary and employment benefits

At Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/help-for-applicants.

Application procedure

Your application must be received no later than 12 October 2026.



We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.





We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Beroendeterapeut/behandlingsassistent
jobs.description:
Vad roligt att du är intresserad av att jobba hos oss!

Här i västra Värmland, bland vidsträckta sjöar och grönskande skogar, finns en stark glöd som sprider värme och lyser upp. Glöden är vår vision och ledstjärna. I Arvika kommunkoncern jobbar idag cirka 2 700 kompetenta medarbetare. Välkommen du också!

Socialtjänst och arbetsmarknad

Vill du bli en del av Socialtjänst- och arbetsmarknads väletablerade öppenvård och arbeta med kollegor som har lång erfarenhet inom socialt arbete? Vill du bedriva behandling i grupp och individuellt med 12-stegsprogrammet som bas? Vill du också hjälpa oss att utveckla vår verksamhet för att vi på ett bättre sätt ska tillgodose våra invånares behov?

Då är det här rätt tjänst för dig! Vi söker nu en engagerad och kompetent beroendeterapeut alternativt behandlingsassistent till vår öppenvård.

Som beroendeterapeut/behandlingsassistent blir man en del av Enheten för socialt stöd till vuxna som består av två sjuksköterskor, nio boendestödjare, två beroendeterapeuter samt en enhetschef. Arbetet utgår från vår öppenvård Omnibus.

Tjänstgöringsgrad för denna tjänst är 75 % men under en projekttid år, 2026–2027, är tjänsten utökad med 25 %. Detta innebär att du utöver dina huvudarbetsuppgifter kommer ha ett extra ansvar att driva på verksamhetsutveckling i förhållande till uppsökande verksamhet och anhörigstöd samt utveckling av verksamheten utifrån framtidens socialtjänst och den kommande samsjuklighetsreformen.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen som beroendeterapeut/behandlingsassistent ser vi att du har:

    Utbildning som beroendeterapeut, behandlingsassistent eller alternativt har du annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som lämplig.
    Tidigare erfarenhet av behandlingsarbete med vuxna människor, gärna i form av både gruppverksamhet och individuellt stöd.
    Tidigare erfarenhet av att prata inför grupper och tycka att det är roligt då Behandlingsarbetet på öppenvården Omnibus innehåller stor del föreläsningsmaterial.
    B-körkort.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och i skrift.

Det är även meriterande om du också har:

    Erfarenhet av behandlingsarbete inom ramen för 12-stegsprogrammet.
    Utbildning i Motiverande intervju, MI, likaså om du har utbildning i Återfallsprevention ser vi som positivt.
    Gärna ha yrkeserfarenhet av alla de målgrupper som socialtjänsten kan möta utöver skadligt bruk/ beroende: våld i nära relation, socialpsykiatri och bostadslöshet. Vi ser också gärna att du har vana av fältarbete med människor i utsatta situationer.
    (Vid egen erfarenhet av skadligt bruk/beroende är det önskvärt att ha genomgått behandling för egen del samt några års nykterhet/drogfrihet efter det).

Som person är du stabil, initiativtagande och strukturerad. Du visar prov på gott omdöme och har en hög personlig mognad. Du är van att skapa förtroendefulla relationer och är trygg i mötet med människor i utsatta livssituationer. God samarbetsförmåga krävs då det är grunden för vårt samarbete både inom och utom den egna verksamheten. Det är viktigt att du har en god empatisk förmåga och att du har en hög grad av struktur i ditt arbete. Eftersom verksamheten och därigenom öppenvården ständigt utvecklas behöver du vara medveten om vikten av kvalité och du behöver vara engagerad i verksamhetsutveckling.

Personlig lämplighet och mognad kommer att vara avgörande rekryteringsprocessen.

Ansvarsområde

I ditt dagliga ansvar som beroendeterapeut/behandlingsassistent ingår det att:

    Tillsammans med din beroendeterapeutkollega kommer du ansvara för att bedriva behandlingsverksamhet gentemot människor med skadligt bruk och beroendeproblematik.

Arvika kommunkoncern samarbetar med Varbi i rekryteringsärenden och det är också vårt rekryteringsverktyg för att hantera ansökningar samt ett led i att kvalitetssäkra vår rekryteringsprocess. jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Digital Twin Modelling and Multi-Timescale Optimization of Electrolysis Systems
jobs.description:
Help to build the digital backbone of tomorrow's Power-to-X plants. This 3-year PhD position offers a unique opportunity to build a research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems. You will drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies, integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand, to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolysers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University, and research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
You will develop and validate digital-twin and optimization methods for electrolysis systems, working both independently and collaboratively with the group and with academic and industrial partners. In particular, you will:

  • Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven, or hybrid digital twins of Electrolysis systems, capturing their electrochemical, thermal, flow, and system-level behaviour for system monitoring, state estimation, and performance prediction.
  • Build computationally efficient models suitable for monitoring, performance prediction, optimization, and control, and evaluate their accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and practical applicability. They could also be implemented in real-time systems.
  • Investigate interactions across operational timescales (Multi-timescale optimization) — from short-term power, thermal, and flow management to longer-term production scheduling and energy-system operation — connecting fast system dynamics with slower operational decisions.
  • Develop optimization strategies to improve Electrolyzer performance, efficiency, flexibility, and economic operation under variable electricity supply and renewable-energy integration.
  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project activities.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies 
We expect you to have:

  • A relevant master's degree in energy engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, control engineering, or a related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in at least one of: electrochemical or energy-system modelling, dynamic modelling and control, mathematical optimization, or data-driven modelling.
  • Experience with numerical modelling, simulation, optimization, control, or engineering-data analysis.
  • Good programming skills in Python, MATLAB/Simulink, or a comparable scientific computing environment.
  • A fundamental understanding of energy-conversion systems, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, heat and mass transfer, electrochemistry, or control engineering.
  • The ability to conduct independent, systematic, and scientifically rigorous research while working effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with some of the areas of electrolyzer technologies, digital twins, model order reduction, system identification, power electronics, model predictive control, multi-objective optimization, machine learning, renewable-energy integration, experimental testing, or hardware-in-the-loop implementation would be an advantage. You are not expected to have expertise in all of these areas.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are
The PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • A project description (3–5 pages) outlining your initial thoughts and ideas on the project applied for, including a brief state-of-the-art with a short list of references, a time schedule, and how you intend to address the project objectives.
  • Publications, if applicable.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do
  • Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto’s drone and autonomy platform.
  • Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
  • Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
  • Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
  • Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
  • Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
  • Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
  • Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
  • Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
  • Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
  • You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
  • You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
  • Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
  • You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
  • You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
  • You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
  • Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
  • Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
  • Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
  • Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
  • Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
  • Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
  • Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
  • A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
  • Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
  • Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
  • You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
  • You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
  • You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
  • You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission.We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ambitious ideas into technology that works in the real world.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background, experience and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, computer-vision experience, the systems and products you have worked on, and your approach to solving complex perception problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team.The exercise will be based on a computer-vision problem relevant to the role. We are interested in how you structure the problem, reason about algorithms and architecture, evaluate trade-offs and collaborate with other engineers rather than looking for one specific answer.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have a meaningful opportunity to influence both our technology and how we build it.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have room to challenge approaches, shape technical decisions and take ownership of important parts of our computer-vision stack.Most importantly, your work will move beyond experimentation. You will see the technology integrated, tested and used on real systems in demanding environments.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential.Due to the nature of our work, certain positions may be subject to security-clearance or other eligibility requirements in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Postdoc Position in System Optimization Using Digital Twin for Power-to-X processes
jobs.description:
Take the next step in your research career at the intersection of digital twins, multi-timescale system optimization, and integrated Power-to-X systems with special focus on the electrical engineering parts. This position offers a unique opportunity to drive the development of system-level digital-twin and optimization methodologies—integrating electrolyzer models with renewable generation, power electronic conversion, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand—to enable more efficient, flexible, and economically viable Power-to-X operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of November 2026 or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the project
The position is affiliated with the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery (CAPeX) and the section for Applied Power Electronic Systems. You will join an interdisciplinary team working across electrolyzers, Power-to-X systems, power electronics, control, digital twins, and energy-system optimization, in close collaboration with the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), University of Toronto, Stanford University, and Utrecht University — research visits to partner facilities may form part of the position.

Your work tasks
This two-year postdoctoral project focuses on the system-level integration and optimization of electrolyzer digital twins within CAPeX — considering how component-level electrolyzer models and digital twins can be incorporated into broader Power-to-X systems involving renewable generation, power conversion, power system integration, energy and hydrogen storage, downstream processes, and energy demand. In particular, you will:

  • Develop an integrated, system-level digital-twin framework connecting electrolyzer models with relevant Power-to-X components and energy-systema.
  • Develop system-level optimization and energy-management methods for coordinating electrolyzers with renewable generation, power conversion, storage, downstream processes, and hydrogen demand.
  • Apply and evaluate these methods under technical constraints and varying renewable generation, electricity prices, and hydrogen demand, considering system efficiency, flexibility, production, and operating costs.
  • Validate and benchmark the developed framework using project data, high-fidelity simulations including hardware in the loop, and relevant industrial case studies, assessing its robustness and computational performance.
  • Collaborate with researchers and industrial partners, contribute to the coordination and supervision of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision of bachelor's and master's students in areas related to your expertise.

Your competencies
We expect you to have:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in energy-system modelling, mathematical optimization, control, digital twins, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and numerical modelling skills using Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, hardware in the loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as multi-objective optimization, model predictive control, mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, energy management, or production scheduling.
  • Good knowledge of integrated energy systems; experience with electrolyzers, hydrogen technologies, renewable-energy integration, storage, or Power-to-X systems would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be a specialist in every electrolyzer technology or optimization method. Strong system-level modelling and optimization competence, together with the ability to work across component and system boundaries, is particularly important.

Who we are
The position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based in Aalborg. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply

Do you have any questions?

For professional questions, please contact Frede Blaabjerg, Professor, fbl@energy.aau.dk, +45 2129 2454.

Further information

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

• Préparer et nettoyer les données nécessaires aux analyses.
• Participer à la mise en place de flux de données fiables et exploitables.

Data Science & Machine Learning

• Explorer et analyser des jeux de données complexes.
• Préparer et transformer les données pour les modèles analytiques.
• Développer des modèles de Machine Learning.
• Participer à des travaux de prédiction, classification, régression et optimisation.

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Business Intelligence, Informatique, Statistiques ou dans un domaine similaire.

Vous disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle significative dans les domaines de la BI, de la Data/ de l'IA.

Vous devez comprendre les problématiques traditionnelles de Business Intelligence et de reporting, tout en ayant une vision plus large des possibilités offertes par la Data Science, le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, AMXL EU Supply Chain Execution
Job ID: 10533977 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and as cost effectively as possible.
Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network

A day in the life

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.

About the team

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

- Experience working with databases and SQL
- Experience in project or program management
- Experience with operations/supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

jobs.title: Information Security Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Nous recherchons actuellement un(e) Information Security Officer (m/f/n)


Vos missions:

Déployer et faire évoluer la stratégie, les politiques et le cadre de gouvernance cybersécurité de l'entité.  
Identifier, évaluer et suivre les risques cybersécurité et à la protection des données ainsi que les plans de remédiation associés.  
Assurer la conformité aux exigences réglementaires, aux politiques internes et aux obligations liées à la protection des données.  
Piloter la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information et de la protection des données de DEEP France, en veillant à leur alignement avec les exigences du Groupe et les obligations réglementaires applicables.  
Animer les comités locaux de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données, produire les indicateurs de pilotage et assurer l'alignement avec les instances de gouvernance de DEEP France et de POST Telecom.
Conseiller la Direction et les équipes métiers sur les enjeux de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des risques.  
Définir et promouvoir les mesures organisationnelles et techniques nécessaires à la protection des systèmes d'information.  
Développer la culture cybersécurité à travers des actions de sensibilisation et de formation.  
Contribuer à la définition et à l'exécution du plan de contrôle annuel de sécurité et de protection des données, en assurer le suivi et le reporting des résultats.
Piloter les audits de sécurité et de conformité, suivre les plans de remédiation et coordonner la mise en œuvre des actions correctrices liées aux non-conformités identifiées.
Contribuer, en binôme avec l'Information Security Officer de POST Telecom et les équipes Compliance, au maintien, à l'amélioration continue et aux audits de certification ISO/IEC 27001 du SMSI.  
Contribuer à la gestion des incidents de sécurité, à la continuité d'activité et à la reprise après sinistre en collaboration avec les équipes spécialisées.  
Assurer une veille réglementaire et technologique et représenter l'organisation auprès des autorités et parties prenantes concernées.  
Favoriser la cohérence des pratiques de sécurité entre DEEP France et POST Telecom et maintenir une proximité avec les équipes via des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites.


Votre profil:

Diplôme de niveau Master (ou expérience équivalente) en Informatique, Cybersécurité ou Sécurité de l'information.
Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle lié à la cybersécurité, à la gouvernance SSI ou à la gestion des risques.
Bonne maîtrise des technologies de l'information et des principes de sécurité des systèmes d'information.
Connaissance des référentiels et normes de sécurité (ISO 27001, ISO 27005, ISO 22301) ainsi que des réglementations et standards du marché.
Une ou plusieurs certifications en cybersécurité, gestion des risques ou gouvernance SSI constituent un atout.
Esprit d'analyse, de synthèse et d'amélioration continue.
Capacité à proposer des solutions innovantes, pragmatiques et à faire preuve d'initiative.
Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, d'écoute et de communication.
Français et anglais courants. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

jobs.title: Responsable des Opérations – Construction / Travaux (m/f)
jobs.description:
Responsable des Opérations – Construction / Travaux

Reference: LU878909

Luxembourg
Permanent
Retail

Notre client est une PME luxembourgeoise établie et en développement, active dans la réalisation de projets d'aménagement et de travaux pour une clientèle privée, professionnelle et institutionnelle.

Dans le cadre de son plan de développement et afin de renforcer son organisation, la société souhaite recruter un Responsable des Opérations.
Directement rattaché à la Direction Générale et membre du Comité de Direction, vous prenez en charge le pilotage des activités opérationnelles et d'un portefeuille de projets menés simultanément.

Le poste combine une véritable dimension de management des opérations, gestion multi-projets et pilotage de la performance, tout en nécessitant de rester proche des équipes et de la réalité des chantiers.

Vos responsabilités :

• Piloter et coordonner l'ensemble des activités opérationnelles et des projets en cours ;
• Superviser les Conducteurs de Travaux et assurer une allocation efficace des équipes entre les différents chantiers ;
• Structurer et optimiser la planification des projets, depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur réalisation et leur facturation ;
• Suivre l'avancement des différents chantiers, identifier les points de blocage et définir les priorités ;
• Piloter la rentabilité des projets, suivre les marges, les coûts et les principaux indicateurs de performance ;
• Garantir la qualité des réalisations et le respect des engagements pris auprès des clients ;
• Assurer le bon déroulement des projets remportés dans le cadre d'appels d'offres privés ou publics ;
• Maintenir une relation de qualité avec les clients et intervenir lorsque les enjeux du projet le nécessitent ;
• Participer, aux côtés de la Direction Générale, à la structuration de l'organisation et à l'amélioration continue des méthodes de travail ;
• Contribuer plus largement au développement de l'entreprise et à la professionnalisation de ses opérations.

Votre profil

• Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en gestion de projets, conduite de travaux ou management d'opérations, idéalement acquise dans la construction, le bâtiment, le génie civil, les travaux, l'aménagement ou un environnement comparable. Le client reste volontairement ouvert sur le secteur d'origine : la maîtrise d'un environnement de chantier et du pilotage de projets est plus importante qu'une expertise sectorielle spécifique.
• Vous avez par exemple pu évoluer comme Conducteur de Travaux senior, Responsable de plusieurs projets, Responsable de Programmes ou Responsable des Opérations et souhaitez aujourd'hui prendre davantage de responsabilités.

Au-delà de votre expertise opérationnelle, vous savez :

• gérer simultanément plusieurs projets et arbitrer les priorités ;
• comprendre et piloter la rentabilité d'un chantier ;
• coordonner différents interlocuteurs et équipes ;
• conserver une vision globale tout en entrant dans le détail lorsque nécessaire ;
• évoluer avec aisance entre le terrain, les clients et la Direction Générale.

Nous recherchons surtout une personnalité pragmatique, énergique et impliquée, avec un réel sens des responsabilités et de la relation client. Vous appréciez les environnements entrepreneuriaux dans lesquels les décisions sont rapides et où votre impact sur l'organisation est directement visible.

Pourquoi rejoindre cette entreprise ?

Il s'agit d'une fonction nouvellement structurée et centrale dans le développement de l'entreprise, offrant une forte autonomie et une proximité directe avec la Direction Générale.
Vous rejoindrez une société à taille humaine avec de réelles ambitions de développement, dans un rôle permettant à la fois de piloter l'activité existante et de contribuer à construire l'organisation de demain.

jobs.description:
English speaking Junior Auditor - Starting date: January 2027 (m/f/d)

Job Description

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.
We offer excellent career prospects that balance autonomy, flexibility, and responsibility. Our comprehensive benefits inspire our people do and feel their best.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

We are seeking our future Junior Auditors - Starting in January 2027 (m/f/d)

We act in the public interest and the capital market, and we are committed to delivering quality audits, enabled by the power of technology and the strength of our people.  By leveraging leading technologies, we are transforming the audit experience for our professionals and our clients - enabling us to provide an even higher quality audit by increasing our ability to focus on the issues that matter through the data and insights it provides.  

What your responsibilities and challenges will be

• Provide audit services to a variety of companies and have the opportunity to develop your skills in IFRS and local GAAP
• Participate in audit and accounting projects serving both domestic and global clients across diverse industries such as banking, insurance, asset management, real estate, private equity or CIPS (commercial industries & public sector)
• Gain solid audit, financial and accounting knowledge
• Build trust with clients and create a strong relationship with them
• Work in an international environment where the business language is English
• Work in multicultural teams with people from diverse backgrounds and countries

What you will be working on

As a junior you will:  

• Bridge the gap between your theoretical expertise and the practical implications of emerging global accounting standards and international mandates, cultivating a profound mastery of standards like IFRS and local GAAP
• Work on a diversified portfolio of international clients and meet them (face-to-face or virtually)
• Learn how a wide variety of organizations are working, including reviewing their systems and processes to be able to advise the companies that you will audit
• Give stakeholders confidence by reviewing the financial statements of a company
• Execute our audit approach, which involves evaluating the client's operational landscape, appraising risk factors and internal control structures, conducting financial statement audits, and formulating targeted suggestions and specialized reports
• Be a part of innovative projects to improve our processes and tools

What we look for 

Effective auditors possess a combination of technical and soft skills, including:

• Qualification: you hold a bachelor/master's degree or you are about to graduate soon in either audit, accounting, finance or engineering / IT, and you are interested in undertaking professional accountancy qualifications (e.g. IRE)
• Analytical skills: the ability to analyze financial data, identify anomalies, and assess the financial health of an organization
• Attention to detail: a keen eye for accuracy and a commitment to thorough documentation and review
• Communication skills: effective verbal and written communication skills to build and maintain excellent relationships with clients and teams, and the ability to work on your own initiative and as part of a team
• Ethical integrity: a strong commitment to ethical conduct and independence to maintain the credibility of the audit process
• Problem-solving: the capacity to identify and resolve complex financial issues and discrepancies
• Time management: efficiently manage multiple engagements and meet deadlines
• Language skills: you are fluent in English, any other language would be an asset

What you will get 

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.
