As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month.

Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions.
  • Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices.
  • Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation.
  • Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback.
  • Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards.
  • Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.
  • Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution.
  • Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks.
  • Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team.
  • Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc.
  • Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team.
  • Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP.
  • Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript.
  • Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews.
  • Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks.
  • Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users.
  • Proficiency with spoken and written English.
  • Fluency with Git.
  • Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone.
  • Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply:

  • Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment.
  • Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework).
  • Building user-facing LLM integrations.
  • Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa.
  • Integrating with Stripe for payment processing.

An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.



Benefits

  • Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries.
  • Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change.
  • Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance.
  • Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options.

 

Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only):

  • Health & Wellness: 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%.
  • Work-Life Balance: 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave.

 

*Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

Senior Shopify Developer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

 

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

Key Responsibilities Process and issue invoices for all installations and services on a daily basis, ensuring billing is accurate, complete and issued in a timely manner. Design and maintain databases and analytics dashboards used to track customer accounts, installation dates, contractual pricing and billing activity, ensuring data integrity across the finance function. Provide billing updates to the Financial Controller as required, escalating pricing or billing matters where necessary. SQL and database design skills, with the ability to model and work with customer and billing data. Demonstrated ability to analyse billing and customer account data, and to identify and resolve discrepancies. Experience designing or supporting automation and analytics dashboards within a billing or finance environment. Strong Excel skills and experience working with billing or invoicing systems. Sound understanding of data accuracy, billing controls, and contractual pricing terms. jobs.title: Verslunarmaður
jobs.description:
Nettó Höfn í Hornafirði leitar að starfsfólki í tvö störf við áfyllingu kvöld/nætur. Um er að ræða starf þar sem vinnutími er að jafnaði frá kl. 20:00–04:00, sex daga vikunnar.
Starfið felst fyrst og fremst í áfyllingu og frágangi á vörum að kvöldi og nóttu. Stærstur hluti vinnutímans er eftir lokun verslunar en hluti vaktar getur verið á opnunartíma.

Starfið hentar vel einstaklingi sem er sjálfstæður, skipulagður og vinnur rösklega. Mikilvægt er að geta unnið eftir skipulagi vinnustaðar, forgangsraðað verkefnum og sýnt frumkvæði.

Helstu verkefni:
1.    Áfylling og frágangur á vörum
2.    Framstilling og tiltekt í verslun
3.    Móttaka og frágangur vöru eftir þörfum
4.    Aðstoð við viðskiptavini á opnunartíma
5.    Önnur tilfallandi verkefni í verslun
Hæfniskröfur:
1.    Sjálfstæði og ábyrgð í starfi
2.    Skipulögð og vönduð vinnubrögð
3.    Dugnaður og geta til að vinna rösklega
4.    Frumkvæði og geta til að forgangsraða verkefnum
5.    Góð enskukunnátta

Greitt eftir kjarasamningi VR

Fyrirtækið útvegar ekki húsnæði né aðstoðar við leit að húsnæði


Umsóknafrestur er til og með 08.10.2026

Vinsamlegast sækið um starfið á Mínum síðum eða með því að senda umsókn netfangið: laun@samkaup.is

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst/Product and Services Management
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst/Product and Services Management Support for a company in Jönköping. Start is November 1st, 13 months limited contract to begin with - possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Jönköping.

Assignment Description

﻿

Be a part of the company's journey to establish the foundation for offering more digital services. For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.

﻿

Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers. You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission. Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.

In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization. You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

﻿

Your future challenge

This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager. This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

﻿

Tasks

• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.

• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.

• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.

• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.

• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.

• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

﻿

Required skills

﻿

• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.

• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.

• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).

• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Jönköping through Incluso. Start is November 1st, 13 months limited contract to begin with - possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Jönköping.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer- EV charging & Battery Storage
jobs.description:
The role combines pre-sales technical support, solution design, customer training, commissioning, and after-sales support. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, production, installers, and other partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide pre-sales technical consultation and solution design for EV charging, BESS, and PV projects.

· Prepare technical solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions, including:

o System sizing and architecture

o Product selection and configuration

o EV charger, BESS, and PV integration

o Economic analysis to identify cost-effective system configurations

· Support the sales team with technical clarification, project discussions, and the preparation of technical proposals.

· Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations independently.

· Perform or support on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and configuration of EV chargers and BESS systems.

· Provide after-sales technical support, including fault analysis, troubleshooting, and coordination with customers, installers, and internal engineering teams.

· Work closely with R&D and product teams to communicate field feedback and support technical issue resolution and product improvement.

· Travel mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to other Nordic and European markets as required for commissioning, troubleshooting, training, customer visits, and other technical support activities.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation, or another relevant technical field.

· Good understanding of industrial low-voltage (LV) electrical systems, particularly 400 V three-phase systems commonly used in commercial and industrial applications.

· Familiarity with electrical components and equipment such as power cables, circuit breakers, protection devices, energy meters, current transformers (CTs), controllers, switches, relays, and electrical distribution equipment.

· Ability to understand basic cable sizing, electrical connections, power distribution, protection concepts, and equipment interfaces.

· Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, technical documentation, and system diagrams.

· Comfortable working hands-on with electrical and control equipment during testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.

· Able to independently perform basic system checks, equipment configuration, commissioning preparation, and fault diagnosis within the scope of the role.

· Strong interest in renewable energy, energy storage, EV charging, smart energy management, and electrification technologies.

· Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales teams, engineers, customers, installers, and other partners.

· Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are considered strong advantages:

· Previous experience in EV charging infrastructure, BESS, power systems, renewable energy, PV, EMS, or related technologies.

· Experience working with 400 V LV distribution systems, switchboards, electrical cabinets, meters, controllers, and related field equipment.

· Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, or technical support of electrical or power electronic equipment.

· Practical understanding of power cables, cable selection, CTs, energy meters, protection devices, and electrical measurement equipment.

· Experience using common electrical measurement and diagnostic tools during commissioning and troubleshooting.

· Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as Modbus TCP/RTU, OCPP, Ethernet, RS485, or similar industrial communication systems.

· Basic understanding of industrial networking, IP configuration, and communication between chargers, BESS, meters, controllers, and EMS systems is an advantage.

· Swedish or European electrical qualification/certificate, or relevant practical experience in electrical installation and commissioning.

Personal Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

· Technically curious and willing to continuously learn new products and technologies.

· Genuinely interested in the rapidly developing EV charging, energy storage, and renewable energy industries.

· Customer-oriented and comfortable communicating technical topics with different stakeholders.

· Hands-on and willing to participate in field testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning.

· Structured, responsible, and capable of managing multiple technical tasks or projects in parallel.

· Flexible and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-growing technical environment.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in an inspiring environment where you can support research and internationalisation? The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) Grants Office is looking for an experienced, skilled, and passionate Research Coordinator who is proactive, well-versed in external funding, and motivated to make a meaningful difference for researchers across the university.

The SLU Grants Office is a unit within the Division of Planning and Research Support. We provide expertise, support, advice, and information on external research funding to researchers, administrators, and university leadership. Our friendly, helpful, and professional team has a wide range of experience and expertise, enabling us to provide strategic and operational support both pre- and post-award. Our work focuses on proposal-writing advice and constructive feedback, budgeting, administration, and project management. We also provide information and capacity-building initiatives. We are currently based at SLU’s main campuses – Alnarp, Ultuna, and Umeå – but we all work to support the entire university.

Read more about the Grants Office at https://internt.slu.se/grantsoffice/.

Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.

Duties:

As our new Research Coordinator, your primary role will be to work with SLU researchers who are leading applications for collaborative grants such as Horizon Europe Pillar II, MSCA Doctoral Networks, and European Partnerships, with flexibility to support other initiatives as needed. You will offer targeted advice and guidance to SLU coordinators during the pre-award phase, assisting with developing suitable concepts, reviewing proposal texts, and recommending improvements. Additionally, you will provide broader support across SLU through outreach, capacity-building and communication efforts.

More specifically, together with colleagues, you will:

    Support researchers applying for external funding, primarily by providing constructive feedback on proposal drafts and helping them craft a clear, persuasive narrative aligned with the scope of the call.
    Disseminate information about future funding opportunities, proactively identify prospective applicants, and encourage them to apply.
    Design and deliver seminars and workshops focused on funders, funding opportunities and proposal writing, and contribute to events co-organised with other units at SLU.
    Provide input on external funding strategies, including those discussed by SLU’s Strategic External Funding Team.
    Represent the Grants Office and SLU at internal and external networks.
    Support SLU Grants Office communications and outreach, including newsletters and web pages, and developing self-help training materials.

This list is not exhaustive and may change depending on SLU and the Grants Office’s needs. Depending on your personal competencies and interests, there is also scope to propose new initiatives and ways of working.

Please note that, due to the nature of the role, occasional domestic and international travel is required.

Qualifications:

Please use your application to demonstrate how you meet the essential and any applicable meritorious criteria listed below. We will place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position.

Essential

    Experience working in research support within higher education or research institutes.
    The ability to understand complex funding calls and applications and to offer straightforward advice and guidance to academic colleagues.
    Experience with Horizon Europe Pillar II.
    Knowledge and understanding of national and international funding sources, including their guidelines and mechanisms.
    An excellent communicator, expressing yourself well in writing and speech.
    Confidence and flexibility of approach, with the ability to work independently and to collaborate with others.
    The ability to prioritise your own workload under pressure and meet set deadlines whilst maintaining a high degree of quality.
    Excellent people skills with the ability to develop professional relationships and networks at all levels within and beyond the university.
    Excellent command of the English language, written and spoken.
    An undergraduate degree.

Meritorious

    Postgraduate education and/or research experience.
    Experience working at research funding agencies or as an expert evaluator for proposals or projects.
    Experience with Marie Skłodowska Curie Doctoral Networks, European Partnerships, and other collaborative funding programmes.
    Knowledge of EU research policy.
    Experience writing or contributing to large research grant applications.
    Experience in outreach and communications, e.g. newsletters, webpages or blogs, or organising events.
    Experience in developing and delivering training sessions.
    Knowledge of how AI may be used appropriately, effectively, and responsibly in the context of research proposal support.
    Knowledge of the Swedish language, both written and spoken (SLU’s language policy requires staff to be able to understand information in Swedish after 4 years of employment).

Interview Process

Stage 1    Online interview in English (approx. 30 minutes) plus a written assignment (max. one hour).

Stage 2    In-person interview in English (approx. 1 hour).

Place of work

Ultuna (near Uppsala), Alnarp (near Lund), or Umeå. The position requires occasional domestic and international travel.

Form of employment

Substitute employment for 2 years, with the possibility of extension.

Extent

100%. Hybrid working is an option (max. 2 days per week).

Starting date

According to agreement.

Application

Please click the ‘Apply’ button below to submit your application. The deadline is October 9, 2026.

jobs.title: Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Improve production economics through operational financial analysis



Would you like to support investment and operational decisions through reliable financial analysis? As Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist, you will analyse production, testing and maintenance costs, identify financial risks and model future capacity scenarios. You will help Operations Karlskrona use resources and capital efficiently while NKT expands the cable production required for the green transition.







Translate operational costs into informed business decisions



Working within Operation Analytics, you will examine cost factors across production, testing, equipment, maintenance and material flows. You will connect financial information with capacity, staffing and operational forecasts, while considering energy prices, raw materials, inflation and policy developments. Your findings will support budgeting, forecasting, investment calculations and expansion planning.



Your responsibility will be to:




    Analyse cost factors across production, testing and material flows
    Prepare financial forecasts for capacity, staffing, equipment and maintenance
    Identify financial risks and opportunities within operational processes
    Support budgeting, forecasting and investment calculations
    Provide weekly cost signals and quarterly financial scenarios



The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden, and involves close cooperation with Operations and Finance as well as other operational functions. You will support line organisations in using cost optimisation methods and models. Any travel requirements will be discussed during the recruitment process.





Profile description:

Commercially minded analyst with a practical operational approach



You are structured, curious and able to consider both financial and operational perspectives. You communicate complex findings clearly and enjoy working with colleagues from different functions. You assess assumptions carefully, ask relevant questions and provide balanced recommendations. You also take a collaborative approach to sharing methods and helping operational teams use financial information in everyday decision-making.



You also have:




    Experience analysing operational costs and cost variations
    Knowledge of financial forecasting and scenario planning
    Experience with budgeting and investment calculations
    Understanding of production, testing, maintenance or capacity economics
    Ability to prepare financial decision material from operational data







Support sustainable growth through better resource decisions



We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This position provides opportunities for career development, cross-functional collaboration and continued development of your financial and operational skills in an international environment. You will contribute to investment, capacity and resource decisions while learning from colleagues across Operations, Finance and related functions during NKT’s continued expansion.







“As a leader, I value clear analysis that helps our teams identify capacity constraints early and make well-founded operational decisions,” says Hiring Manager, Magnus Röstlund.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 28.09.2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Dejan Zegarac, Global Talent Attraction Specialist, at Dejan.Zegarac@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.







We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.







Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Materials Science and Photoelectrocatalysis
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a full-time position as Associate Professor in the section of Electrochemistry at the Department of Chemistry.


About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

The research in the Section of Electrochemistry focuses on the materials science and fundamental understanding of electrochemical processes, and their utilization in sustainable energy conversion technologies. The section is at the forefront of solid-state ionics, particularly in the development of proton ceramic electrochemical cells, including intermediate-temperature fuel cells, electrolysers and membrane reactors. Central research themes include defect chemistry and ionic/electronic transport in materials and at interfaces, and kinetic processes at surfaces. 

This position will be part of a major effort towards development of emerging technologies. This is a joint initiative across several Faculties at the University of Oslo, and in particular related to a research theme on photo-electrocatalysis for clean production of energy carriers and chemicals.

Over the past decade, the research activities have expanded into photo- and electrocatalysis at low and ambient temperature, including CO2 conversion, artificial photosynthesis, and gas-phase (photo)electrochemical cells. These activities build on our long-standing expertise and infrastructure in high-temperature electrochemical systems.

The Section for Electrochemistry works closely with Sections for Catalysis, Inorganic Materials Chemistry, and Solid-state Physics and Quantum Technology within the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology (SMN), which provides access to a broad range of facilities with state-of-the-art instrumentation. 

The new associate professor is expected to take active part in and further develop these collaborations, and to make strategic use of this infrastructure in pioneering research on functional materials, photo- and electrocatalysis, and technology development within sustainable energy conversion. Computational materials science has taken a central role in the section’s activities, alongside extensive use of synchrotron facilities through the Swiss-Norwegian Beamlines (SNBL) at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facilities (ESRF).

The Section for Electrochemistry currently has two permanent faculty members and plays a central role in research and education in materials science and electrochemistry, with a strong focus on sustainable energy technologies. To consolidate and further develop the section’s activities in research, supervision and teaching, we seek to employ a new associate professor who will strengthen and expand our efforts in electrochemical energy conversion and related areas, and who will contribute the section’s development both in depth and in new directions.


More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in physical or inorganic chemistry or materials science and have a strong scientific track record within the area of photo/electrocatalysis.
  • A strong track record and/or a clear potential for research that will lead to technology development. 
  • Scientific qualifications will play a major role, and the main emphasis will be on the candidate’s scientific production from the last five years.
  • Documented potential for acquisition of external funding
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, equivalent to B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. A track record in scientific and administrative leadership is an advantage.
  • International network, outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to create a good working environment will be part of the evaluation.
  • The person appointed will be requested to take on some administrative duties. Hence such experience will be an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 750 000 - to 880 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at 
u io.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.
If you have an i mmigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (1–4 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the near future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Department of Chemistry is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. 

As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Forandringsstærk teamleder, der lykkes i fællesskab
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at forme og understøtte Efter- og Videreuddannelsesområdet på Absalon? Vi søger en udviklingsorienteret teamleder, der kan omsætte ambitioner til resultater og skabe følgeskab i forandringer. Du skal kunne navigere mellem forskellige interesser og faglige perspektiver, være nysgerrig og lyttende – og samtidig have gennemslagskraft til at holde fast i retningen, når det er nødvendigt.

Du bliver en del af et tæt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvor du sammen med en erfaren teamlederkollega skal stå i spidsen for et nyt samlet team og skabe endnu stærkere sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og den samlede udvikling af vores efter- og videreuddannelsesområde.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der kombinerer stærke ledelseskompetencer og en udviklingsorienteret tilgang. Området er komplekst, og derfor er der brug for god, sammenhængende ledelseskraft ind i området. Du skal sammen med en teamlederkollega lede EVU-teamet som et stærkt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvilket sætter store krav til samarbejde, stærke relationer og kommunikation. Sammen skal I skabe sammenhæng mellem de store ambitioner for området og hverdagens udfordringer. For at lykkes i dette er det væsentligt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Dine relationelle kompetencer er helt i top. Til hverdag vil du få en bred samarbejdsflade med medarbejdere og ledere på tværs af Absalon. Din evne til at etablere relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige kolleger er afgørende. Du har et stærkt strategisk perspektiv og med din gode gennemslagskraft, evner du at udvikle driften ud fra den strategiske linje.

Du har erfaring med styring af processer i en kompleks organisation. Det ligger dig naturligt at inddrage og samarbejde med relevante samarbejdspartnere i organisationen. Du er processtærk og har erfaring med at gennemføre udviklings- og forandringsprocesser i en kompleks organisation. Du har et helhedsblik og evner at procesplanlægge, optimere arbejdsgange, dataunderstøtte og udarbejde objektivt begrundede beslutningsoplæg. Du er optaget af både udvikling og implementering i hverdagspraksis.

Du har ledelseserfaring. Din ledelsesstil er inddragende, nysgerrig og dialogorienteret, og du formår at motivere samarbejdspartnere og medarbejdere mod fælles mål. Du har erfaring med at lede udviklingsprocesser, styre projekter og involvere de rette interessenter. Du spiller din lederkollega god, bringer egne perspektiver tydeligt i spil og kan stå på fælles beslutninger. Som personaleleder er du optaget af at styrke trivslen hos den enkelte medarbejder og teamet som helhed.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har kendskab til eller interesse for uddannelsessektoren
  • kommunikerer enkelt og præcist på skrift
  • har en relevant uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du skal forvente, at du vil have opgaver, der knytter sig til følgende ledelsesroller: strategisk ledelse, drifts – og faglig ledelse, personaleledelse og - udvikling samt udvikling af dig selv og din måde at lede på. Konkrete arbejdsopgaver der skal løses, vil bl.a. være:

Udvikling af EVU-området. Vi har høje ambitioner for Absalons efter- og videreuddannelse og vi står over for en spændende udvikling, hvor både samarbejdsformer, processer og opgaveløsning skal udvikles. Sammen med din lederkollega skal du være med til at professionalisere understøttelsen af det samlede EVU-område og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og organisationens strategiske ambitioner. Det indebærer bl.a. udvikling af tydelig governance, stærkere beslutningsgrundlag baseret på data og sikker implementering af nye løsninger.

Kvalitetssikring af leverancer. I den daglige drift er det vigtigt, at du mestrer at driftslede, prioritere opgaveløftet og sikre den løbende dialog med uddannelsernes konsulenter og ledere, samt følger konstruktivt og systematisk op på tilbagemeldinger m.v.

Personaleledelse. Som personaleleder er du tillidsfuld og sikre rammerne for god trivsel i teamet. Derudover har du fokus på at skabe højt engagement, hvor opgavernes og samarbejdets formål er klart defineret. Du skal skabe overblik og tydelige rammer for medarbejdernes arbejde samt for opgavefordelingen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Uddannelsesservices EVU-team, hvor vi dataunderstøtter, udvikler og administrerer efter- og videreuddannelse. Teamet består af mange forskellige fagligheder, og vi er tilsammen 20 medarbejdere. Din lederkollega og du vil begge have personaleledelse for hver jeres medarbejdergruppe, og tilsammen vil I have fælles ansvar for teamets opgaveløft og det strategiske ledelsesansvar.

Uddannelsesservice har 5 teams. Vi håndterer også al optagelse, administration og vejledning af studerende på vores professionsbachelor- og ingeniøruddannelser. Tilsammen er vi 94 kolleger i Uddannelsesservice, som er en velfungerende og uhøjtidelig afdeling, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores kontorer ligger side om side med undervisningslokaler, og vi arbejder tæt på de studerende og tæt med hinanden. Vi vægter kollegial trivsel højt og har brug for, at du også er en holdspiller. Vi har en uformel omgangstone og har mange bolde i luften, som vi gør os stor umage med at gribe.

Vi holder til på vores Campus i Slagelse, som er nemt at komme til, da det er placeret lige ved stationen. Absalon har en dejlig frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse hurtigst muligt
  • Du kan forvente et lønniveau på 700.000 kr. - 800.000 kr. årligt inkl. pension.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Chef for Uddannelsesservice Randi Mølager på telefon 7248 1280.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” til højre på denne side senest den 1. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 5.oktober og 2. samtale den 8. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner – og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Library Events, Development and Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
**General Mission**

The Coordinator is responsible for the development and programming of the library. They organise activities and events, develop partnerships, and contribute to the librarys visitor numbers.

They are also responsible for monitoring the collections, handling returned books, and keeping the library organised.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Library Programming and Development**

- Increase the librarys visitor numbers and appeal, taking into account the expectations and needs of its audiences.

- Promote the librarys spaces and collections by developing projects and events.

- Develop a range of paid activities and services.

- Manage the library shop and coffee area.


**2\. Talks and Debates**

- Design and organise talks, debates, lectures and events.

- Identify and invite authors, experts, associations and other relevant speakers or personalities.

- Encourage discussion, participation and interaction among different audiences.


**3\. Partnerships and Collaborations**

- Identify, develop and maintain a network of partners.

- Build partnerships and joint projects with external organisations and stakeholders.


**4\. Library Space and Collection Management**

- Ensure the efficient day-to-day operation of the library and report any issues or malfunctions.

- Handle returned books and ensure that materials are properly shelved and organised.

- Maintain the collections, including classification, presentation, repairs and replacement of damaged or missing items.

- Select and order new books and other materials.


**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, independent and curious person who is proactive and enjoys interacting with the public. The successful candidate will play an active role in the cultural and commercial development of a welcoming and open community space.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence in interacting with the public and partners.

- Ability to create and develop partnerships.

- Initiative and ability to propose and deliver projects.

- Commercial awareness and ability to identify potential sources of funding.

- Strong organisational skills, autonomy and versatility.

- A passion for reading, discussion and the exchange of ideas.


**Practical Information**

- Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, renewable

- Working hours: 80%, spread over 4 days per week

- **Salary :** €2,268 gross per month

- Start date : October 2026

- Languages: English at C1 level required; French at B2 level preferred; Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

jobs.title: Hydrauliikka-asentaja, laivateollisuus
jobs.description:
Etsimme hydrauliikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun! Asiakasyrityksemme on erikoistunut laivateollisuuteen ja he tarjoavat kattavasti hydrauliikkahuolto- ja korjauspalveluita toimipisteellään, telakoilla ja aluksilla.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

\- Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta tekniikkaa ja koneita kohtaan, kyvykkyyttä sitoutua tehtävään, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, kykyä omatoimiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn, joustavuutta sekä rehtiä ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. jobs.description:
In English:

About Lomac A/S
Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.
We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.

We offer

  • Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
  • Modern machinery and good working conditions
  • Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
  • Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
  • A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development


Job content

  • MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
  • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
  • Quality control of your own work
  • Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlines


We expect that you

  • Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
  • Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
  • Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
  • Can work independently and as part of a team
  • Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented


Requirements for applicants

  • Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
  • Can communicate in English and/or German
  • Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)


Terms of employment

  • Number of positions: 10–15
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Employment type: Permanent position
  • Working model: Rotation scheme – employees work a set period in Denmark, followed by a period at home, before returning to Denmark. The preferred rotation is 4 weeks of work followed by 2 weeks off. Travel to and from Denmark is at the employee’s own expense.
  • Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
  • Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour
  • Overtime: We follow the current overtime pay rules of the Confederation of Danish Industry
  • Employee benefits: Housing and work clothing is provided
  • Collective agreement: Employment conditions are based on the applicable Collective agreement with the Confederation of Danish Industry (DI).

Jonas Nielsen, Business Coordinator
Lomac A/S

Phone: +45 42 13 39 02

How to apply
Send your application and CV to jni@lomac.dk As soon as possible.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management
